name: Exp_ATR_Trailing
author: Copyright ฉ 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA is a trailing stop utility that modifies the stop-loss of existing open positions based on the ATR_Trailing custom indicator. It does not open new positions itself; it only trails stop-losses for already-open buy or sell positions. The trailing logic tightens stops as price moves in favor, locking in profits according to ATR-based levels.

name: K_eSimpleMA
author: tsaktuo
description: This EA uses a dual EMA crossover system to generate trade signals. It buys when a shorter-period EMA crosses above a longer-period EMA and sells on the opposite crossover. Each trade is placed with fixed lot size, stop loss, and take profit levels.

name: EA_AML_1-01
author: Adaptive Market Level
description: This EA trades based on the Adaptive Market Level (AML) custom indicator, which uses fractal dimension analysis to create an adaptive smoothing line. It opens a buy when the AML value is inside the previous bar's range (between open and close with close > open), and opens a sell when AML is inside the range of a bearish bar. When an opposite signal occurs and use_opposite is enabled, it closes the current position and reverses.

name: TradePad
description: TradePad is a graphical trade panel utility EA that provides a visual interface (CTradePanel) for manual trading operations on the MetaTrader 5 chart. It does not generate its own trading signals but instead delegates all user interactions from chart events, ticks, and timers to the CTradePanel object for order management and display.

name: TradeChannel
author: Integer
description: This EA trades breakouts of a price channel (Donchian-style support/resistance). It opens buy positions when price breaks above resistance and sell positions when price breaks below support, with ATR-based stop loss and a trailing stop feature. Position sizing can be fixed or risk-based, with a lot reduction mechanism after consecutive losses.

author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on crossover signals from a double-smoothed moving average indicator (X2MA). It opens buy positions when the X2MA values turn upward and sell positions when they turn downward, with configurable permissions for entry and exit. The strategy applies two sequential smoothing algorithms to a selected price type to generate trend-following signals.

name: Exp_AdaptiveCyberCycle
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on crossover signals from three adaptive cycle-based oscillators (Adaptive Cyber Cycle, Adaptive CG Oscillator, or Adaptive RVI). It opens buy positions when the main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_AMkA
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: Exp_AMkA is an Expert Advisor whose source code could not be read (binary file format). Based on the filename convention 'Exp_' prefix and 'AMkA' abbreviation, this appears to be a systematic trading EA, but its exact strategy, indicators, and logic cannot be determined without access to the actual source code.

name: Exp_AroonSignal
author: Copyright © 2011, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the custom AroonSignal indicator, entering long when an up-signal appears and short when a down-signal appears. It uses Aroon overbought/oversold levels to detect momentum shifts and manages positions with fixed stop-loss and take-profit. A historical bar scan searches backward for the last signal direction to determine close signals when no new signal is present.

name: Exp_3Parabolic
author: Copyright © 2011, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA uses three Parabolic SAR indicators on different timeframes (H6, H3, H1) to generate trend-following trade signals. A buy signal occurs when all three SAR values are below their respective close prices, with the fastest timeframe showing a fresh bullish reversal. Sell signals are the inverse. Positions are managed with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_3rdGenerationXMA
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on signals from the 3rd Generation XMA (Extended Moving Average) indicator, entering long when the smoothed value rises and short when it falls. It uses configurable smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, JJMA, etc.) and applies multi-timeframe analysis with a default H4 timeframe. Position sizing supports either fixed lot or percentage-based allocation, with stop loss and take profit for risk control.

name: Exp_BBands_Stop
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades Bollinger Band stop signals, entering long when the upper band stop value is active and the lower band confirms direction, and vice versa for shorts. It uses the custom BBands_Stop_v1 indicator on a configurable timeframe with fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit levels. Position sizing is controlled via a deposit share or fixed lot parameter.

name: Exp_BBSqueeze
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the BBSqueeze indicator, which detects Bollinger Band squeeze (low volatility) breakout conditions. It opens long positions when the upper histogram bar is non-empty and the previous lower bar confirms direction, and vice versa for shorts. Positions are managed with fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit levels, with optional money management based on deposit share.

name: Exp_Bezier
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the Bezier curve smoothing indicator, generating buy signals when the curve slopes upward and sell signals when it slopes downward. It operates on a multi-timeframe basis, using a higher timeframe indicator to signal trades, and includes both entry and exit logic with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.

name: EWM
description: EWM (Elliott Wave Markup) is an interactive charting utility for manual Elliott Wave analysis and annotation on MetaTrader 5. It provides tools for drawing, dragging, and managing wave labels, pitchforks (Andrews), and performing automated wave pattern recognition via the EWA module, but does not open trades on its own.

name: Exp_XMACD
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the XMACD custom indicator, offering four distinct signal modes: zero-line breakthrough, MACD direction change, signal line direction change, and MACD-signal line crossover. It opens and closes positions according to the selected mode with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit settings.

name: Exp_Arrows_Curves
author: Copyright © 2011, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom Arrows_Curves indicator, opening buy positions on buy arrows and sell positions on sell arrows. It supports configurable money management, stop loss/take profit, and separate permissions for entry and exit. The strategy also searches historical bars for stop signals to close existing positions when no direct close signal is generated.

name: Exp_BrakeExp
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the custom BrakeExp indicator, which generates up/down momentum signals and trend states. It opens buy positions on up-signals and sell positions on down-signals, while closing opposite positions when the trend confirms against them. Position sizing uses a flexible MM parameter that supports either deposit-percentage or fixed-lot sizing.

name: Exp_BrakeExp
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the custom BrakeExp indicator, opening buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals while closing opposing positions. It uses a trend-following approach with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit levels, operating on a user-specified timeframe.

name: Exp_BrakeParb
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom BrakeParb indicator, opening buy/sell positions when the indicator generates trend change signals and closing positions when the trend reverses. It uses a multi-timeframe approach with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. The strategy is a systematic trend-following system with separate permissions for entry and exit on both sides.

name: Exp_BullsBears
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the crossover of Bulls and Bears power indicators, entering long when bulls overpower bears and short when bears overpower bulls. It uses customizable smoothing algorithms for signal generation and includes fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels with position closing logic. Trade execution is restricted to new bar formation on the specified timeframe.

name: Exp_BullsBearsEyes
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the ColorBullsBearsEyes custom indicator, which is a smoothed Bulls/Bears oscillator. It generates buy and sell signals depending on the selected algorithm mode (trend direction change, midline breakdown, or overbought/oversold level breakthroughs), and manages positions with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_BuySell
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the custom BuySell indicator, which uses an MA and ATR combination to identify trend direction. It opens buy positions when an uptrend signal appears and sell positions when a downtrend signal appears, with configurable stop loss and take profit. The EA includes separate permissions for entering and exiting long and short positions, allowing flexible trade management.

name: Terminator V2
author: Integer
description: This EA opens positions based on one of six selectable signal strategies (MACD, Pivot, Support/Resistance, i_Trend+RSI, i_Trend+RSI+Stochastic, i_Trend+RSI+Stochastic+MFI) and employs a progressive lot-sizing scheme that doubles the lot for the first N additions and then uses 1.5x multiplier thereafter. It adds to positions at fixed pip intervals and applies a simple trailing stop, making it a signal-based martingale-style grid-addition system.

name: Exp_wlxBWWiseMan-2
author: Copyright © 2014, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the wlxBWWiseMan-2 custom indicator, which is part of the Bill Williams trading system (Wiseman-2 signal). It opens buy positions on upward wisdom signals and sell positions on downward signals, with optional counter-position closing based on historical signal scanning. Position sizing uses a money management module from TradeAlgorithms.mqh with configurable margin modes.

name: Exp_HullTrend
author: Copyright © 2014, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the HullTrend custom indicator, which uses a Hull Moving Average to determine trend direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. The EA includes money management options and separate controls for opening and closing positions on each side.

name: Exp_TSI_MACD
author: Copyright © 2014, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the custom TSI_MACD indicator, which combines True Strength Index smoothing with MACD-style signal line logic. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable position sizing, stop loss, and take profit. Trade entry and exit are controlled by separate boolean flags, allowing flexible signal filtering.

name: Exp_TSI_CCI
author: Copyright © 2014, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the TSI_CCI custom indicator, which combines True Strength Index smoothing with CCI momentum. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable position closing and money management options.

name: Exp_TSI_WPR
author: Copyright © 2014, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on crossover signals from a custom TSI_WPR indicator, which combines the True Strength Index with Williams' Percent Range. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above its signal line and sell positions on the reverse crossover, with configurable money management and position closing options.

name: Exp_Karpenko
author: Copyright © 2014, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the custom 'Karpenko' indicator, which uses a 144-period MA with historical analysis. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. Position management is handled through the TradeAlgorithms library with multiple margin mode options.

name: Exp_SlopeDirectionLine
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the SlopeDirectionLine custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend (value=2) and sell positions when it signals a downtrend (value=0). It uses a double-smoothing approach with configurable smoothing methods and manages both entry and exit signals independently with separate toggle switches.

name: Exp_TSI_DeMarker
author: Copyright © 2014, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the crossover signals of the TSI_DeMarker custom indicator, which combines DeMarker oscillator values with True Strength Index (TSI) smoothing. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable position closing and money management options.

name: Exp_MaRsi-Trigger
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA uses a dual RSI and dual MA crossover system to identify trend direction changes and generate trading signals. It compares a short-period RSI against a long-period RSI and a short-period MA against a long-period MA, combining both signals to confirm trend shifts. Trades are opened only on trend reversals where both indicator pairs agree on the new direction.

name: Exp_MaByMa
author: Copyright © 2014, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on crossover signals from a custom 'MaByMa' indicator, which smooths one moving average by another. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit levels.

name: YURAZ_CLOSEPRC_V3_1
author: YuraZ
description: This EA trades based on close price analysis, comparing the current bar's close price relative to previous bars to detect momentum shifts. It opens positions when the close price confirms a directional momentum move and manages exits through take profit and stop loss levels. The strategy is a simple price-action momentum system without complex indicator dependencies.

name: chtrailing
author: Andrey Litvichenko, MetaQuotes Software Corp.
description: This EA is a channel-based trailing stop utility that manages existing positions by moving stop losses according to a highest-high/lowest-low channel with an offset. It also implements a 'noose' trailing mechanism that mirrors the take-profit distance to set a symmetric stop loss, and optionally deletes pending orders when a position is opened.

name: Exp_ExchangePrice
author: Copyright © 2014, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the custom ExchangePrice indicator, generating buy signals when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell signals when it crosses below. It uses a new-bar check to avoid repeated entries on the same bar, and manages positions with configurable Stop Loss, Take Profit, and multiple money management modes including lot-based and margin-based sizing.

name: Exp_CenterOfGravity
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin

It opens buy positions when the signal line crosses upward and sell positions when it crosses downward, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. The EA uses a custom CenterOfGravity indicator handle and processes signals on a specified timeframe with new bar detection.

name: Exp_BnB
author: Copyright © 2014, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the BnB (Bulls and Bears) custom indicator, using a smoothed momentum approach to detect trend direction changes. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the reverse crossover, with configurable money management and position closing logic.

name: SignalsDemo
description: This EA is a GUI-based utility that demonstrates signal functionality through a dialog interface. It creates and manages a custom dialog window (CSignalsDemoDialog) on the chart for displaying or interacting with trading signals, but does not open positions itself.

name: Exp_CMO
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the CMO (Chande Momentum Oscillator) indicator, opening buy positions when the CMO crosses from negative to positive territory and sell positions when it crosses from positive to negative. It uses configurable lot sizing, stop loss, and take profit levels, and only processes signals on new bars to avoid redundant trading.

name: QuotesDemo
description: This EA is a utility that fetches and displays Google Finance quotes (world indices, currencies, or bonds) via WebRequest in a custom dialog panel on the chart. It periodically updates the quotes every 10 seconds using a timer and does not place any trades.

name: Exp_BvsB
author: Copyright © 2014, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA uses the BvsB (Bears vs Bulls) custom indicator to generate trading signals based on crossover logic between the indicator line and its signal line. It opens buy positions when the indicator crosses below the signal line from above, and sell positions when it crosses above from below, with configurable position sizing, stop loss, and take profit. The EA supports multiple smoothing methods and applied price types through the SmoothAlgorithms library.

name: Exp_KaufWMAcross
author: Copyright © 2014, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the KaufWMAcross custom indicator, which combines Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average (AMA) with a weighted moving average (LWMA). It opens buy positions on upward crossover signals and sell positions on downward crossover signals, with configurable position closing logic and money management modes.

name: Exp_SimpleBars
author: Copyright © 2014, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom SimpleBars indicator, which analyzes bar color patterns over a configurable period. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals a bullish shift and sell positions on a bearish shift, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options. The strategy only processes signals on new bars to avoid redundant entries.

name: exp_statusbot
description: This EA is a monitoring utility that writes account status, order notifications, and trade history reports to text files. It tracks opened and closed orders by comparing ticket arrays across ticks and outputs changes to a notify file. It does not open, modify, or close any trades on its own.

name: MA L WORLD
author: Ronnie Mansolillo
description: This EA uses a linearly weighted moving average (LWMA) crossover signal between a fast 12-period and slow 25-period MA to generate trade entries and exits. It trails positions using a 92-period EMA and manages risk with a fixed-margin money management module allocating 1% of margin per trade. The strategy is a standard MQL5 Standard Library-based trend following system with configurable signal thresholds and stop/take levels.

name: T3MA(MTC)

description: This EA trades based on the CoeffofLine_true custom indicator, which measures the coefficient of a linear regression line to determine market momentum direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator crosses from negative to positive territory and sell positions when it crosses from positive to negative, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_ColorBBCandles
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the ColorBBCandles custom indicator, which uses Bollinger Band deviation levels to classify candle colors. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an upward bias (value > 5) and sell positions when it signals a downward bias (value < 5), while closing all positions when a flat/neutral signal (value == 5) is detected.

It opens positions when the faster 1-MA crosses above/below the slower 3-MA, and closes positions on the reverse crossover. Position sizing is controlled by a flexible money management parameter that supports either fixed lot sizes or percentage-based allocation.

name: Exp_2MoHLC

It supports two modes: cloud color change (trend reversal) and cloud breakthrough (price breaking through the cloud boundary), opening buy/sell positions accordingly with configurable stop loss and take profit.

description: VR Heads or Tails is a coin-flip style EA that randomly decides market direction (heads=buy, tails=sell) and employs a Martingale position sizing strategy, doubling the lot size after each losing trade to recover losses. It is essentially a gambling-based system with no technical analysis, relying purely on probability and progressive lot scaling to achieve net profit.

name: Exp_2pbIdealXOSMA
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the 2pbIdealXOSMA custom indicator, which is a triple-smoothed oscillator with adjustable smoothing. It generates buy signals when the oscillator histogram turns upward and sell signals when it turns downward, using the slope direction of consecutive histogram bars to determine entries.

name: Double trading
author: MetaQuotes Software Corp.
description: This EA implements a pairs trading / statistical arbitrage strategy by simultaneously opening opposite-direction positions on two correlated currency pairs when their correlation reaches a threshold. It monitors combined profit of both positions and closes them when the total profit target is hit, while also relying on StopLoss/TakeProfit as fallback exits. Auto mode determines trade direction based on session-specific currency strength assumptions.

name: Exp_Oracle
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the custom Oracle indicator, offering three signal modes: zero-line breakthrough, signal line direction change, and indicator/signal line crossover. It opens buy/sell positions with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit levels, and can independently control entry and exit permissions for long and short positions.

name: Exp_AdaptiveRenko
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the AdaptiveRenko custom indicator, which uses ATR or StDev to dynamically size Renko bricks. It opens buy/sell positions when new Renko bricks signal a direction change, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_JBrainSig1_UltraRSI
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA combines two indicators — JBrainTrendSig1 and UltraRSI — to generate trading signals. It offers three operational modes: using JBrainSig1 as a filter for UltraRSI signals, using UltraRSI as a filter for JBrainSig1 signals, or a composition mode where either indicator's open signal paired with the other's close signal triggers a trade. Entry signals require cross-confirmation from both indicators before opening buy or sell positions.

name: Exp_Candles_XSmoothed
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades breakouts from smoothed candle high/low channels. It uses a custom Candles_Smoothed indicator to generate smoothed high and low boundaries, then enters long when price closes above the smoothed high plus a breakout level, and enters short when price closes below the smoothed low minus a breakout level. Positions are closed on reverse signals and managed with fixed stop loss and take profit.

name: EA_MALR_v_1-01
author: Copyright © 2012
description: This EA trades channel breakouts using a custom MALR (Moving Average Linear Regression) indicator. It enters buy when price breaks above the upper channel and sell when price breaks below the lower channel. It supports position overturn (reversal), averaging down, lot increase based on equity, and trailing stop functionality.

name: Exp_ColorX2MA-Parabolic
author: Copyright © 2011, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on signals from the ColorX2MA-Parabolic custom indicator, which combines a double-smoothed moving average (X2MA) with Parabolic SAR logic. It opens buy positions when the indicator's up buffer has a valid value and sell positions when the down buffer has a valid value, with configurable permissions for entries and exits. Positions are closed either on opposite signals or via fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels.

name: Exp_RMACD
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the ColorRMACD indicator, a volume-weighted MACD variant with customizable signal line smoothing. It offers four entry algorithms: zero-line breakout, MACD direction change, signal line direction change, and MACD/signal line crossover. Positions are opened and closed based on these momentum signals with configurable buy/sell permissions and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels.

name: Exp_Kolier_SuperTrend
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the Kolier SuperTrend indicator, opening buy positions on upward trend signals and sell positions on downward trend signals. It uses ATR-based trend detection with configurable multiplier and period, and applies fixed Stop Loss/Take Profit levels for trade management. The EA only enters new trades on new bar formations to avoid excessive trading on tick noise.

name: Ilan 1.6 Dinamic HT
author: developing Vasiliy Sokolov.
description: This EA implements a Martingale-style averaging strategy that opens an initial position based on RSI and price direction, then adds increasingly larger positions (lot multiplication) when the previous position is in loss beyond a dynamic pip threshold. It includes multiple exit mechanisms: take-profit at a weighted average price, equity stop, CCI-based stop, time-based stop, and a trailing stop. The dynamic pip step is calculated from the High-Low range of recent bars, adapting grid spacing to m

name: Exp_TrendValue
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the custom TrendValue indicator, opening buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals. It uses ATR-based sensitivity for trend detection and applies fixed stop loss and take profit levels. Trade execution is controlled by new bar detection and configurable permissions for opening and closing positions.

name: Exp_MACD_Xtr
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom MACD_Xtr indicator, which is an enhanced MACD with volatility-based normalization using ATR, standard deviation, or volume as the source. It opens buy/sell positions on trend signals and closes them when the trend fades or reverses, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.

name: svmTrader
author: MetaQuotes Software Corp.
description: This EA uses two Support Vector Machine (SVM) models trained on standard technical indicators to generate buy and sell trade signals. When an SVM signals a trade, the EA opens a market position and places matching manual stop-loss and take-profit pending orders, using a ticket cache system to pair and manage them as separate trades.

name: Simple MA+ADX EA
author: MetaQuotes Software Corp.
description: This EA combines a Simple Moving Average (SMA) crossover with the ADX indicator to identify and trade trending markets. It enters long when the fast SMA crosses above the slow SMA and ADX confirms trend strength, and enters short on the reverse crossover with ADX confirmation. Exits are triggered by opposing crossover signals or stop-loss/take-profit levels.

name: Exp_LinearRegSlopeV2
author: Copyright © 2011, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the slope of a linear regression line, using the ColorLinearRegSlope_V2 custom indicator. It opens buy positions when the regression slope turns positive and sell positions when it turns negative, with configurable smoothing methods and price types. Entry signals are confirmed on new bars by comparing current and previous indicator buffer values for crossover detection.

name: Exp_VortexIndicator
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the Vortex Indicator crossover signals, opening buy positions when the VI+ line crosses above the VI- line and sell positions when the VI- line crosses above the VI+ line. It uses configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit levels, and restricts trade execution to new bar formation on a specified timeframe.

name: Exp_Extremum
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the custom Extremum indicator, which identifies price extremes (swing highs and lows). It opens buy positions when an upward extremum signal is confirmed and sell positions when a downward extremum signal is confirmed, with optional permissions for entry and exit independently controlled.

name: Exp_UltraWPR
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the UltraWPR custom indicator, which applies multi-stage smoothing to the Williams Percent Range (WPR). It opens buy positions when the smoothed WPR upward line crosses above the downward line and sell positions on the reverse crossover, with configurable permissions for entry and exit.

name: BackToTheFuture
author: jimbulux
description: This EA scrapes real-time stock quotes from Google Finance via WebRequest and compares them against historical prices from a configurable time offset. It opens buy/sell positions when the current price deviation from the historical reference exceeds a defined bar size threshold, aiming to exploit temporary mispricings between the external feed and the broker's price.

name: Exp_AnchoredMomentum
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the Anchored Momentum custom indicator, opening buy positions when momentum crosses above the upper level and sell positions when it crosses below the lower level. It uses a custom indicator handle with configurable SMA/EMA periods and threshold levels for signal generation. Position sizing uses a deposit share mechanism with fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit in points.

name: dde_example
author: © 2005-2007 RickD
description: This EA is a DDE (Dynamic Data Exchange) example that demonstrates how to exchange data between MetaTrader 5 and external applications via the DDE protocol. It does not implement any trading strategy but serves as a technical utility for inter-process communication. The EA likely publishes or subscribes to market data and account information through DDE topics.

name: Exp_FisherCyberCycle
author: Copyright © 2015, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the FisherCyberCycle custom indicator, generating buy signals when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell signals when it crosses below. It uses a configurable money management system with multiple margin modes and supports independent control of position opening and closing for both buy and sell directions.

name: Exp_RangeExpansionIndex
author: Copyright © 2015, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the Range Expansion Index (REI) indicator, opening buy positions when REI crosses above the lower threshold from below and sell positions when REI crosses below the upper threshold from above. It uses configurable money management modes, fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, and processes signals on new bar formation to avoid redundant entries. The strategy is a mean-reversion system that enters when the indicator exits extreme zones.

name: Exp_GG-RSI-CCI
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on signals from the GG-RSI-CCI custom indicator, which combines RSI and CCI with multi-layer smoothing. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend (value=2), sell positions on a downtrend signal (value=0), and optionally closes positions on a flat signal (value=1). Position sizing uses a deposit share model with configurable stop loss and take profit.

name: Exp_Ozymandias
author: Copyright © 2015, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the Ozymandias custom indicator, which signals trend direction changes via buffer values of 0 and 1. It opens buy positions when the indicator switches from 0 to 1 and sell positions when it switches from 1 to 0, with configurable stop loss and take profit. Position management is delegated to the TradeAlgorithms library for both opening and closing trades.

name: Exp_ElderImpulseSystem
author: Copyright © 2015, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA implements Alexander Elder's Impulse System, which combines a 13-period EMA with MACD histogram direction to determine trend impulse. It opens buy positions when both EMA and MACD histogram are bullish, opens sell positions when both are bearish, and closes positions when the impulse reverses. The system uses the custom ElderImpulseSystem indicator buffers to read color-coded signal values for entry and exit decisions.

name: Exp_Modified_Optimum_Elliptic_Filter
author: Copyright © 2015, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the Modified Optimum Elliptic Filter indicator, opening buy positions when the filter values are rising and sell positions when they are falling. It uses a new-bar check to generate signals and applies configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and money management settings. The strategy is a trend-following system that enters in the direction of the filter's slope.

name: Exp_DSSBressert
author: Copyright � 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the DSS Bressert double smoothed stochastic indicator, opening buy positions when the smoothed stochastic crosses upward and sell positions when it crosses downward. It uses a crossover of two indicator buffer lines (UpValue/DnValue) on a configurable timeframe to generate entry and exit signals, with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_UltraFatl
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the UltraFatl custom indicator, a multi-period smoothed trend-following oscillator. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from below 5 to above 4, and sell positions when it transitions from above 4 to below 5, using the signal bar crossover logic. Positions are managed with fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit levels, with optional position closing on reverse signals.

name: Exp_Leading
author: Copyright © 2015, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the custom 'Leading' indicator, which uses two EMA-like smoothing lines with configurable alpha coefficients. It opens buy positions when Ma1 crosses above Ma2 and sell positions when Ma1 crosses below Ma2, with optional close-on-reverse-signal functionality and fixed stop loss/take profit levels.

name: Exp_HLRSign
author: Copyright © 2015, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom HLRSign indicator, which identifies overbought and oversold conditions using Highest Low Range levels. It opens buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals, with configurable entry/exit logic and money management modes.

name: Exp_FatlSatlOsma
author: Copyright © 2015, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the FatlSatlOsma custom indicator, which is an OSMA-style oscillator derived from FATL (Fast Adaptive Trend Line) and SATL (Slow Adaptive Trend Line) digital filters. It opens long positions when the oscillator values show increasing momentum (Value[0] > Value[1] > Value[2] is not required, but Value[1] < Value[2] with Value[0] > Value[1]) and short positions on decreasing momentum, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_simple_trading_system
author: Copyright © 2015, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA implements a simple trend-following trading system based on a custom indicator called 'simple_trading_system' that generates up/down arrow signals. It opens buy positions on up signals and sell positions on down signals, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels, and supports multiple money management modes including lot-based and margin-based sizing.

name: Exp_TrendlessAG_Hist
author: Copyright © 2015, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the TrendlessAG_Hist custom indicator, which applies double smoothing to a detrended price oscillator. It opens buy positions when the histogram rises and sell positions when it falls, with configurable signal bar and smoothing parameters.

name: Exp_NRatioSign
author: Copyright © 2015, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the NRatioSign custom indicator signals, which is a normalized ratio oscillator with configurable smoothing and price inputs. It opens buy positions when the indicator's upper buffer signals and sell positions when the lower buffer signals, with separate controls for entry and exit. The EA supports multiple money management modes and fixed stop loss/take profit levels.

name: AutoRKD EA
author: Bigsea QQ:806935610
description: An Example of a Trading System Based on a custom Indicator RKD

name: Exp_AFL_WinnerSign
author: Copyright © 2015, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom AFL_WinnerSign indicator, which identifies momentum-based buy and sell signals. It opens buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options. The EA includes both entry and exit logic driven by the same indicator, supporting position reversal or independent close signals.

name: RiskManager
author: Anatoly Sergeev
description: RiskManager is a utility EA designed to monitor and manage risk across open positions and the overall account. It provides real-time risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits, position size validation, and automated protective actions when risk thresholds are breached. The EA does not open trades based on its own signals but acts as a safeguard layer for other trading strategies.

name: Exp_XMA_Ichimoku_Channel
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades breakouts of the XMA Ichimoku Channel, buying when price closes above the upper channel border and selling when price closes below the lower channel border. It uses customizable smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, JJMA, etc.) to construct the channel from averaged high/low prices with percentage-based band offsets. Exit signals are generated when price re-enters the channel after a breakout.

name: Exp_ForexProfitBoost_2nb
author: Copyright © 2015, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA uses a custom indicator ForexProfitBoost_2nb, which combines two moving averages with Bollinger Bands, to generate buy and sell signals. It opens and closes positions based on the intersection of upper and lower indicator buffer signals, with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit levels. The EA operates on a new bar basis and supports independent control of buy/sell opening and closing.

name: Exp_XMA_Range_Bands
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades breakout signals from the XMA_Range_Bands indicator, which constructs an upper and lower band around a smoothed moving average. It opens buy positions when price closes above the upper band and sell positions when price closes below the lower band, with configurable permissions for entries and exits. Positions are managed with fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit levels, and lot sizing supports either a fixed lot or a percentage of deposit.

name: Exp_AsimmetricStochNR
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the custom AsimmetricStochNR indicator, which is an asymmetric Stochastic with noise reduction. It opens buy positions when the Stochastic main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the reverse crossover, with independent permissions for entry and exit.

name: CHART_BRING_TO_TOP(GET)
author: Copyright © 2015, Vladimir Karputov
description: Determine the active chart

name: Exp_ADXCrossing
author: Copyright © 2015, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the ADXCrossing custom indicator, which signals trend direction changes when the +DI and -DI lines cross. It opens buy positions on upward crosses and sell positions on downward crosses, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit settings. The EA also supports closing opposite positions on signal reversal and uses a new-bar check to avoid repeated signals within the same bar.

name: StopLevelCounter
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin & Aleksey Rodionov
description: This is a utility indicator that displays the profit/loss for a user-specified lot size at a draggable horizontal price level. It calculates and shows the potential profit for both buy and sell positions based on the distance between the current Bid/Ask and the user-placed stop level. It does not open, manage, or close any trades automatically.

name: jpalonso-modoki
author: alohafx
description: This EA uses the Envelopes indicator as a mean-reversion signal within the MQL5 Standard Library Expert Advisor framework. It opens trades when price touches or crosses the Envelopes bands, expecting a reversion to the moving average center line. The EA uses fixed lot sizing and no trailing stop, with hardcoded stop-loss and take-profit levels.

name: Exp_3XMA_Ishimoku
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA uses a triple smoothed moving average system based on the Ishimoku concept, comparing a central XMA line against upper and lower envelope lines derived from high/low price smoothing. It generates buy signals when the XMA crosses above the envelope ceiling and sell signals when it crosses below the floor, with configurable smoothing methods and multi-timeframe support.

name: Exp_ADX_Smoothed
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the smoothed ADX indicator's DI+ and DI- lines. It enters long when DI+ crosses above DI- and short when DI- crosses above DI+, with configurable permissions for opening and closing positions. Position sizing uses a money management parameter that can represent either a fixed lot size or a percentage of the deposit.

name: MD5 Cloud Decryptor
description: MD5 Cloud Decryptor is a utility Expert Advisor that connects to cloud-based MD5 hash decryption services to resolve hash values. It does not execute any trading operations and serves purely as an informational/analytical tool within the MetaTrader 5 environment.

name: Exp_AML
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the ColorAML custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend (value=2) and sell positions when it signals a downtrend (value=0). It uses configurable lot sizing, stop loss, and take profit levels, with permission switches for each trade direction and position closing. The strategy operates on a multi-timeframe basis, running the indicator on a user-specified timeframe while executing on the chart timeframe.

name: Exp_ColorNonLagDotMACD
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the ColorNonLagDotMACD custom indicator, offering four distinct signal algorithms: zero-line breakout, MACD direction change, signal line direction change, and MACD-signal line crossover. It opens and closes positions on new bar events with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit settings.

name: Exp_ColorMETRO
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the ColorMETRO custom indicator, which uses RSI with fast and slow step sizes to generate momentum signals. It opens buy positions when the RSI fast line crosses above the slow line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable permissions for entry and exit. Position sizing uses a money management parameter that can operate as either a deposit percentage or fixed lot size.

name: Exp_BlauTVI
author: Copyright © 2015, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the BlauTVI (Trend Vigor Index) indicator developed by William Blau. It generates buy signals when the indicator rises (value increasing) and sell signals when it falls (value decreasing), with separate controls for opening and closing positions. The EA uses triple-smoothed momentum to identify trend vigor and executes trades on new bar formation.

name: Exp_XRVI
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the XRVI (Refined Volume Index) custom indicator, generating buy signals when the XRVI main line crosses above its signal line and sell signals on the reverse crossover. It uses advanced smoothing algorithms (JJMA, JurX, etc.) for both the indicator and signal line calculations, with configurable money management and position permissions.

name: Exp_ColorStepXCCX
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the ColorStepXCCX custom indicator, which uses step-filtered moving averages with dual smoothing. It enters long when the fast line crosses above the slow line and short when it crosses below, with configurable permissions for opening and closing positions independently.

name: Exp_ColorJVariation
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the ColorJVariation custom indicator, which is a JMA-smoothed variation oscillator. It opens buy positions when the indicator value rises consecutively (Value[0]>Value[1]>Value[2] pattern) and sell positions when it falls consecutively, with separate permissions for entry and exit.

name: Exp_MovingAverage_FN
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the MovingAverage_FN custom indicator, which applies a configurable Fourier noise filter to a smoothed moving average. It opens buy positions when the filtered MA turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with optional position closing on reverse signals. The strategy is a trend-following system using multiple smoothing methods and a Fourier-based noise reduction filter.

name: Exp_ColorZeroLAG_MA
description: This EA trades based on the ColorZeroLAG_MA indicator, which is a zero-lag moving average composed of two smoothing layers. It opens buy positions when the zero-lag MA turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable buy/sell enable switches and separate close-on-reverse logic. Position sizing uses multiple money management modes including fixed lot, balance percentage, and free margin percentage.

name: Exp_ColorZerolagRVI
description: This EA trades based on the crossover signals of the ColorZerolagRVI indicator, a zero-lag composite RVI (Relative Vigor Index) oscillator built from five weighted RVI components. It opens buy positions when the main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels. Trade execution is restricted to new bar formation to avoid redundant signals within the same candle.

name: Exp_ColorZerolagTriX
description: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the ColorZerolagTriX custom indicator, which is a zero-lag weighted combination of five TriX (Triple Exponential Moving Average) oscillators. It opens buy positions when the fast oscillator crosses above the slow one and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_CenterOfGravityOSMA
description: This EA trades based on the Center of Gravity OSMA indicator, which is an oscillator-derived signal combining center of gravity calculations with double-smoothed moving averages. It opens buy positions when the OSMA histogram turns upward from a declining state and sell positions when it turns downward from a rising state, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_ColorZerolagTriXOSMA
description: This EA trades based on the ColorZerolagTriXOSMA custom indicator, which is a zero-lag composite of five weighted TriX (Triple Exponential Moving Average) oscillators smoothed with OSMA-style histogram logic. It opens buy positions when the histogram turns upward (value rising from below) and sell positions when the histogram turns downward, with configurable permissions for entry and exit on each side.

name: HFT Spreader 4 FORTS
author: Serhiy Dotsenko
description: HFT: спредер для FORTS   HFT: spreader for FORTS

name: Exp_ColorZerolagRSIOSMA
description: This EA trades based on the ColorZerolagRSIOSMA custom indicator, a zero-lag composite RSI smoothed with SMA. It opens buy positions when the indicator turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable position sizing and stop loss/take profit levels.

name: Well Martin
author: AM2
description: This EA uses Bollinger Bands and ADX to identify mean reversion entry points when price touches the outer bands during low-trend conditions. It employs a Martingale position sizing strategy that multiplies lot size by a factor after each losing trade. Stealth mode allows virtual stop-loss and take-profit levels that are not visible to the broker.

name: Exp_ColorZerolagMomentumOSMA
description: This EA trades based on the ColorZerolagMomentumOSMA custom indicator, which is a zero-lag momentum oscillator smoothed with OSMA-style processing. It opens buy positions when momentum rises and sell positions when momentum falls, with configurable position sizing and stop-loss/take-profit management.

name: Exp_OsHMA
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the OsHMA (Oscillator of Hull Moving Average) indicator, supporting two entry modes: zero-line breakout and histogram direction change (twist). It opens buy/sell positions with configurable stop loss and take profit, and can independently control entry and exit permissions for long and short positions.

name: Exp_ColorZerolagX10MA
description: This EA trades based on the ColorZerolagX10MA custom indicator, which is a zero-lag composite moving average built from 10 differently-perioded smoothing lines with weighted factors. It opens buy positions when the indicator turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable buy/sell open and close toggles. Position sizing and trade execution are handled through the TradeAlgorithms library with multiple money management modes.

name: Exp_ColorJMomentum
description: This EA trades based on the ColorJMomentum custom indicator, which applies JMA smoothing to a Momentum oscillator. It opens buy positions when the smoothed momentum turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable entry/exit direction controls and money management options.

name: Exp_ColorJLaguerre
description: This EA trades based on the ColorJLaguerre indicator, which is a Laguerre-filtered JMA oscillator that outputs trend states as integer values. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from state 1 to 2 and sell positions when it transitions from state 2 to 1, with configurable position closing on opposite signals. Money management and stop-loss/take-profit are handled via the included TradeAlgorithms library.

name: Exp_ColorStochNR
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the ColorStochNR custom stochastic indicator, offering five distinct entry algorithms including level breakthrough, oscillator direction change, signal line twist, oscillator crossing signal line, and signal line crossing the 50 level. It opens and closes positions on new bars using the selected algorithm and delegates trade execution to an included TradeAlgorithms library for position sizing and order management.

name: Exp_ColorMaRsi-Trigger
description: This EA trades based on the ColorMaRsi-Trigger custom indicator, which combines dual-period RSI with dual-period MA to generate buy and sell signals. It opens buy positions when the indicator crosses above zero and sell positions when it crosses below zero, with configurable position closing on opposite signals. Money management supports multiple margin modes including fixed lot sizing.

name: Exp_ColorSchaffMFITrendCycle
description: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffMFITrendCycle custom indicator, which applies a Schaff trend cycle to MFI (Market Facilitation Index). It opens buy positions when the cycle crosses above the high level and sell positions when it crosses below the low level, with configurable position sizing and stop loss/take profit.

name: Exp_ColorSchaffMomentumTrendCycle
description: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffMomentumTrendCycle custom indicator, which is a Schaff-style momentum oscillator with trend cycle smoothing. It opens buy positions when the oscillator rises above the high level and sell positions when it drops below the low level, with configurable position closing on opposite signals.

name: Exp_ColorSchaffRSITrendCycle
description: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffRSITrendCycle custom indicator, which is a Schaff Trend Cycle applied to RSI values. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from a low color zone to a higher one and sell positions on the reverse transition, with configurable buy/sell open/close toggles and money management options.

name: Exp_ColorMomentum_AMA
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on signals from the ColorMomentum_AMA custom indicator, which applies Adaptive Moving Average (AMA) smoothing to a Momentum oscillator. It opens buy positions when the smoothed momentum is rising and sell positions when it is falling, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and lot sizing based on deposit share.

name: Exp_ColorSchaffRVITrendCycle
description: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffRVITrendCycle custom indicator, which combines fast and slow RVI (Relative Vigor Index) with a cycle-based trend detection algorithm. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals bullish momentum (color buffer >5 crossing from neutral) and sell positions on bearish momentum (color buffer <2 crossing from neutral), with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_ColorSchaffTriXTrendCycle
description: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffTriXTrendCycle custom indicator, which is a Schaff Trend Cycle variant built on TriX momentum. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from high color values (>5) downward and sell positions when it transitions from low color values (<2) upward, with configurable position sizing and stop loss/take profit.

name: Exp_ColorSchaffWPRTrendCycle
description: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffWPRTrendCycle custom indicator, which applies a Schaff trend cycle to Williams' Percent Range (WPR) with fast and slow periods. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from a bullish color zone and sell positions when it transitions from a bearish color zone, with configurable signal bar and threshold levels for entry and exit.

name: Exp_ColorXXDPO
description: This EA trades based on the ColorXXDPO custom indicator, which is a double-smoothed Detrended Price Oscillator. It opens buy positions when the DPO turns upward and sell positions when the DPO turns downward, with configurable buy/sell open and close logic switches.

name: Exp_ColorXdinMA
description: This EA trades based on the ColorXdinMA custom indicator, which is a dual-length smoothing average that changes color based on trend direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.

name: Exp_CoppockHist
description: This EA trades based on the Coppock Curve histogram indicator, opening buy positions when the histogram turns upward from below and sell positions when it turns downward from above. It uses a custom CoppockHist indicator with configurable ROC periods, smoothing, and applied price, and delegates trade execution and money management to the TradeAlgorithms library.

name: Exp_CronexCCI
description: This EA trades based on the CronexCCI custom indicator, which applies double smoothing to CCI values to generate trend and signal lines. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable position opening and closing toggles.

name: Exp_CyclePeriod
description: This EA trades based on the CyclePeriod custom indicator, which measures the dominant cycle period of price action. It opens buy positions when the cycle period value rises (shorter cycle = momentum accelerating upward) and sell positions when it falls, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.

name: Exp_ColorLeManTrend
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the ColorLeManTrend indicator, which uses three moving averages (Min/Mid/Max) smoothed by an EMA to determine trend direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator's up-line crosses above the down-line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, while providing configurable permissions for entry and exit. Positions are managed with fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit levels in points.

name: Exp_DiNapoliStochastic
description: This EA trades based on the DiNapoli Stochastic indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below. It supports configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and independent toggle switches for opening and closing positions on both sides. Trades are executed only on new bars to avoid redundant signals.

name: Exp_ColorTrend_CF
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades trend reversals detected by the ColorTrend_CF custom indicator. It opens buy positions when the indicator's upper line crosses above the lower line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management settings.

name: Exp_DigVariation
description: This EA trades based on the DigVariation custom indicator, which applies digital smoothing to a moving average. It opens buy positions when the smoothed value turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.

name: Exp_EMA-Crossover_Signal
description: This EA trades based on the EMA-Crossover_Signal custom indicator, opening buy positions on upward crossover signals and sell positions on downward crossover signals. It supports configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and separate toggle controls for opening and closing positions on both sides. The strategy operates on new bar events with a historical bar lookup to determine if opposing positions should be closed.

name: Exp_EMA_Prediction
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom EMA_Prediction indicator, which uses two EMAs (fast and slow) to predict price direction. It opens buy positions on upward prediction signals and sell positions on downward prediction signals, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and position closing logic. The EA supports multiple money management modes and allows independent control of entry and exit for both long and short positions.

name: Exp_Ergodic_Ticks_Volume_Indicator
description: This EA trades based on the Ergodic Ticks Volume Indicator, which is a momentum oscillator derived from tick volume data smoothed through multiple averaging layers. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable position closing on signal reversals.

name: Exp_Ergodic_Ticks_Volume_OSMA
description: This EA trades based on the Ergodic Ticks Volume OSMA indicator, opening buy positions when the oscillator turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward. It uses a multi-layer smoothed volume-based oscillator to generate trend-momentum signals, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. The strategy enters on signal bar crossovers and closes opposing positions on reversals.

name: Exp_Fast2
description: This EA implements a dual moving average crossover strategy using the custom Fast2 indicator, which applies two smoothing algorithms with configurable methods and periods. It opens buy positions when the faster MA crosses above the slower MA and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with optional position closing on reverse signals and configurable stop-loss/take-profit levels.

name: Exp_FatlMacd
description: This EA trades based on the FatlMacd custom indicator, which is a smoothed digital filter (FATL) combined with a MACD-like oscillator. It opens buy positions when the FatlMacd histogram turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable position closing on opposite signals.

name: Exp_FineTuningMA
description: This EA trades based on the FineTuningMA custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator values show an uptrend (Value[0]>Value[1]<Value[2]) and sell positions when a downtrend is detected (Value[0]<Value[1]>Value[2]). It uses configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and processes signals only on new bars for efficiency.

name: Exp_CorrectedAverage
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: The breakthrough system based on the CorrectedAverage moving average

name: Exp_Force_DiverSign
description: This EA trades based on divergence signals from the custom Force_DiverSign indicator, which identifies bullish and bearish divergences in the Force Index. It opens buy positions on bullish divergence signals and sell positions on bearish divergence signals, with configurable close-on-opposite-signal logic for position management.

name: Exp_ForecastOscilator
description: This EA trades based on the ForecastOscilator custom indicator, opening buy positions on upward oscillator signals and sell positions on downward signals. It supports configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and separate toggles for entry and exit signals. The strategy is a signal-based momentum system with optional reverse-signal exit logic.

name: Exp_FractalAMA_MBK
description: This EA trades based on the crossover signals of the FractalAMA_MBK custom indicator, which is a fractal-adaptive moving average. It opens buy positions when the main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit.

name: Exp_VininI_Trend
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the custom VininI_Trend indicator, which uses multiple smoothed moving averages with variable depths. It supports two entry algorithms: level breakthrough (BREAKDOWN) and direction change (TWIST), with configurable buy/sell permissions and position closing options.

name: Exp_VininI_Trend_LRMA
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the VininI_Trend_LRMA custom indicator, which uses a Linear Regression Moving Average with multi-step smoothing. It supports two entry modes: level breakout and direction change (twist), and optionally filters entries using the ChangeOfVolatility indicator in the version with the second handle. Positions are opened and closed systematically with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management.

name: negative_spread_FORTS
author: 1987pavlov
description: This EA exploits negative spread conditions (when bid > ask) on the FORTS (Russian derivatives) market by placing pending limit orders at the favorable side of the book. It opens a SELL_LIMIT at bid when negative spread is detected, then immediately attempts to close the position with a BUY_LIMIT at ask, capturing the inverted spread as profit. The strategy relies on order book depth events rather than technical indicators.

name: Schnick_Demo
author: MetaQuotes Software Corp.
description: This EA is a demonstration script for a Support Vector Machine (SVM) learning tool. It generates synthetic training data based on a predefined 'Schnick' classification function, trains two SVMs (one with clean data and one with randomly inserted errors), then tests and compares their classification accuracy. It does not execute any actual trades.

name: Exp_ColorHMA
description: This EA trades based on the ColorHMA (Hull Moving Average) indicator, opening buy positions when the HMA slope turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward. It uses the color changes of the HMA to detect trend reversals and manages positions with configurable stop loss, take profit, and multiple money management modes. Trades are only executed on new bars to avoid redundant signals.

name: HVR
author: Copyright © 2015, Nikolay Kositsin
description: HVR (Historical Volatility Ratio) is a custom indicator that calculates the ratio of 6-period historical volatility to 100-period historical volatility, displayed in a separate window. It uses log returns of a selectable applied price and computes annualized standard deviation for both windows. The HTF version allows applying this indicator on a higher timeframe while displaying on the current chart.

name: Exp_DecEMA
description: This EA trades based on the DecEMA (Decimal EMA) custom indicator, opening buy positions when the DecEMA value turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward. It uses a crossover of three consecutive DecEMA buffer values to detect trend direction changes and applies configurable money management for position sizing with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_i-BandsPrice
description: This EA trades Bollinger Bands price crossovers using a custom i-BandsPrice indicator that applies additional smoothing. It opens buy positions when the indicator value crosses down below level 4 and sell positions when it crosses up above level 0, with configurable exit signals based on threshold levels.

name: Exp_i-KlPrice
description: This EA trades based on the i-KlPrice custom indicator, which applies double smoothing (SMA + JJMA) to a KlPrice deviation-based oscillator with overbought/oversold levels. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an upward crossover from the lower level and sell positions on a downward crossover from the upper level, with configurable position closing logic.

name: Exp_iAnchMom
description: This EA trades based on the iAnchMom (Anchored Momentum) custom indicator, which combines SMA and EMA to measure momentum shifts. It opens buy positions when momentum turns upward and sell positions when momentum turns downward, with configurable entry/exit toggles for each direction. Position sizing supports multiple margin modes including fixed lot, balance percentage, and free margin percentage.

name: Exp_Ichimoku_Osc
description: This EA trades based on an Ichimoku Oscillator custom indicator that smooths the difference between Tenkan-sen and Kijun-sen using configurable smoothing algorithms. It opens buy positions when the oscillator turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with optional position closing on reverse signals. Trade sizing is handled via multiple money management modes with fixed stop loss and take profit.

name: Exp_HullTrendOSMA
description: This EA trades based on the HullTrendOSMA custom indicator, which applies Hull moving average smoothing to an OSMA-style oscillator. It opens buy positions when the oscillator turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable money management and separate open/close controls.

name: Exp_ColorZerolagHLR
description: This EA trades based on the ColorZerolagHLR oscillator, a zero-lag composite momentum indicator built from five weighted HLR (High-Low Range) components. It opens buy positions when the oscillator crosses upward and sell positions when it crosses downward, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels. Trading signals are processed only on new bars to avoid redundant entries.

name: Exp_i-AMMA
description: This EA trades based on the i-AMMA (Adaptive Modified Moving Average) indicator, opening buy positions when the AMMA value rises and sell positions when it falls. It uses a crossover-like logic comparing the current and previous bar indicator values to determine trend direction and generate entry/exit signals. Position sizing is configurable through multiple margin modes, and it includes stop loss and take profit for risk management.

name: Puria
author: AM2 Group.
description: Puria is a trend-following EA that uses a triple Moving Average crossover system combined with MACD confirmation to generate buy and sell signals. It enters long when the fast EMA(5) crosses above two slow LWMA(75,85) with MACD above zero, and enters short on the inverse condition. Positions are managed with fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit levels, and only one position at a time is allowed.

name: Exp_Instantaneous_TrendFilter
description: This EA trades based on the crossover signals of the Instantaneous TrendFilter indicator, which uses an Ehlers-style alpha smoothing constant. It opens buy positions when the trend filter oscillator crosses above its signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_ColorXADX
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the ColorXADX custom indicator, which enhances the standard ADX with advanced smoothing algorithms. It enters buy positions when the DI+ line crosses above DI- with ADX above a threshold, and sell positions on the opposite crossover, both confirmed by trend strength. Positions are managed with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_ColorSchaffJJRSXTrendCycle
description: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffJJRSXTrendCycle custom indicator, which combines JJRSX (Jurik Relative Strength Index) with Schaff Trend Cycle logic. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions on downtrend signals, with configurable money management and stop loss/take profit levels.

name: Exp_ColorZerolagJJRSX
description: This EA trades based on the ColorZerolagJJRSX custom indicator, a zero-lag composite JJRSX oscillator. It opens buy positions when the fast oscillator crosses above the slow one and sell positions when the fast crosses below the slow one, with configurable position closing on reverse signals.

name: GlobalVariable
author: Copyright © 2015, Vladimir Karputov
description: Example of work with global variables

name: Exp_ColorZerolagJCCX
description: This EA trades based on the crossover signals of the ColorZerolagJCCX oscillator, a zero-lag composite momentum indicator built from five weighted JCCX components with JJMA smoothing. It opens buy positions when the main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the reverse crossover, with configurable options for entry and exit on each signal direction.

name: Exp_ColorSchaffJCCXTrendCycle
description: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffJCCXTrendCycle indicator, a Schaff trend cycle oscillator built on JCCX (Jurik Composite Color eXtended) with JJMA smoothing. It opens buy positions when the indicator color changes to bullish (above +5) and sell positions when it changes to bearish (below +2), with corresponding close signals. Position sizing is configurable via money management modes including lot-based, balance percentage, and free margin percentage.

name: Exp_EF_distance
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the EF_distance indicator, which measures the efficiency of price movement to detect trend direction. It opens buy positions when the EF_distance values indicate an upward trend (Value[0]>Value[1]<Value[2]) and sell positions when they indicate a downward trend, with an optional Flat-Trend volatility filter in the full version.

name: Exp_KalmanFilter
description: This EA trades based on signals from the KalmanFilter custom indicator, which uses a Kalman filter algorithm to estimate price trends. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an upward trend and sell positions on downward trends, with configurable entry/exit switches and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels. The strategy supports two signal modes: trend-based and Kalman-based, operating on a user-defined timeframe.

name: Exp_derivative
description: This EA trades based on the derivative (rate of change) of a price series, entering positions when the momentum derivative signals a directional shift. It calculates the mathematical derivative of price to detect acceleration or deceleration in trend movement, opening trades when the derivative crosses key thresholds. The strategy aims to capture early trend momentum shifts before they become visually apparent on the chart.

name: Exp_MultiTrend_Signal_KVN
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom MultiTrend_Signal_KVN indicator, which identifies trend direction changes. It opens positions only when the signal indicates a trend reversal from the opposite direction, and closes existing positions when the trend signal flips. Position sizing is controlled via a deposit share or fixed lot input parameter.

name: Exp_KPrmSt
description: This EA trades based on the crossover of two buffers from the custom KPrmSt indicator. It opens buy positions when the first buffer crosses above the second and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and position management settings.

name: Exp_TEMA_CUSTOM
description: This EA trades based on a Triple Exponential Moving Average (TEMA) custom indicator with configurable smoothing methods for each of the three MA layers. It opens buy positions when the TEMA value is rising (Value[0]>Value[1] with Value[1]<Value[2]) and sell positions when falling, closing opposite positions on signal reversal.

name: Exp_XDerivative
description: This EA trades based on the XDerivative custom indicator, which calculates a smoothed derivative of price. It opens buy positions when the derivative turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable money management and separate buy/sell open/close controls.

name: Exp_XKRI_Histogram
description: This EA trades based on the XKRI_Histogram custom indicator, opening buy positions when the histogram rises and sell positions when it falls. It uses configurable money management, fixed stop-loss and take-profit, and provides separate toggles for opening and closing positions on both sides. Signal generation occurs on new bar formation with a one-bar signal delay by default.

name: BreakoutBarsTrend_EA
author: Rone.
description: The Expert Advisor using the BreakoutBarsTrend_v2 indicator. Depending on the settings, the entry in market  is performed in the trend reversal ore after missing the specified number of  negative signals.\n Important! If the reversal is specified in percentage, then the Delta, SL and TP also should be specified in percentage. If the reversal in pips - the Delta, SL and TP also are specified in pips.

name: Exp_LaguerreFilter
description: This EA trades based on the Laguerre Filter indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator's signal line crosses above the filter line and sell positions when it crosses below. It uses a custom LaguerreFilter indicator with a gamma parameter to control smoothing, and includes configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and position sizing. The strategy is a trend-following system that enters on crossover signals and exits on reverse crossovers or SL/TP.

name: Exp_Laguerre_ADX
description: This EA trades based on the Laguerre_ADX custom indicator, opening buy positions when the Up line crosses above the Dn line and sell positions when the Dn line crosses above the Up line. It uses a crossover signal on a specified timeframe with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit levels.

name: Exp_LinearRegSlope_V1
description: This EA trades based on the Linear Regression Slope indicator, opening buy positions when the slope crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below. It uses customizable smoothing methods and price types, with configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and money management parameters. The strategy is a systematic trend-following system that enters in the direction of the linear regression slope crossover.

name: Exp_LSMA_Angle
description: This EA trades based on the LSMA (Least Squares Moving Average) Angle indicator, opening buy positions when the angle crosses upward above threshold and sell positions when it crosses downward. It uses a custom indicator handle to read angle values (0-4 scale) and generates signals on new bar formation, with configurable money management and separate open/close controls for long and short positions.

name: Exp_ColorSchaffDeMarkerTrendCycle
description: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffDeMarkerTrendCycle custom indicator, which combines fast and slow DeMarker oscillators with a cyclical trend component. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from a downtrend color zone to an uptrend zone, and sell positions on the reverse transition, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.

name: EA_TPSLpanel
author: SearchSurf - RmDj (TheHow)
description: This EA is a simple TP/SL panel. TP/SL will not be sent as pending order, and if triggered, it will be executed as an immediate order.

name: Exp_RD-TrendTrigger
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the RD-TrendTrigger custom oscillator indicator, supporting two entry modes: oscillator direction change (twist) and level breakthrough (disposition). It opens buy/sell positions when the oscillator signals momentum shifts and manages exits via stop loss, take profit, and closing signals from the indicator.

name: Exp_MA_Rounding_Candle
description: This EA trades based on signals from the MA_Rounding_Candle custom indicator, which applies a rounding mechanism to a smoothed moving average to generate trend signals. It opens buy positions when the trend shifts upward and sell positions when the trend shifts downward, with configurable money management and position closing logic.

name: Exp_FrAMACandle
description: This EA trades based on the FrAMACandle custom indicator, which combines Fractal Adaptive Moving Average (FRAMA) logic to detect trend direction.
