It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions when it signals a downtrend, with configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and money management options. Entry and exit are controlled by boolean flags for each direction, and trade execution only occurs on new bars to avoid repeated signals.

name: Exp_TriXCandle
description: This EA trades based on the TriXCandle custom indicator, which is a TRIX-based momentum oscillator rendered as candlesticks. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an upward momentum shift and sell positions on a downward shift, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.

name: Exp_CHOWithFlat
description: This EA trades based on the Chaikin Oscillator with Flat (CHOWithFlat) custom indicator, which combines Bollinger Bands with a smoothed Chaikin Oscillator to detect momentum shifts. It opens buy positions when the oscillator's upper line crosses above the lower line and sell positions when the opposite occurs. The EA includes configurable money management, stop loss/take profit, and separate toggles for entry and exit signals.

name: Exp_DigitalF-T01
description: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the custom DigitalF-T01 indicator, which outputs two oscillator lines. It opens buy positions when oscillator 1 crosses above oscillator 2 and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_StepSto_v1
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the StepSto_v1 custom indicator, which appears to be a stepped stochastic oscillator. It opens buy positions when the fast line crosses above the slow line above the 50 level, and sell positions when the fast line crosses below the slow line below the 50 level. Positions are closed on opposing signals, with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_JMACandleSign
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom JMACandleSign indicator, which generates buy/sell signals based on JMA-smoothed candlestick patterns. It opens buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals, with configurable position closing logic and money management options.

name: Exp_XMA_Range_Channel
description: This EA trades breakouts from the XMA_Range_Channel indicator, opening buy positions when price breaks above the upper channel and sell positions when it breaks below the lower channel. It uses configurable smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, JJMA, etc.) for the channel calculation and includes money management, stop loss, and take profit controls. Signal filtering is done via a color buffer system from the custom indicator.

name: LastPrice
author: MetaQuotes Software Corp.
description: This EA monitors the market depth (order book) and places limit orders based on the last traded price relative to the bid/ask spread. It scalps by entering BUY when the last price is above ask plus an interval threshold, and SELL when below bid minus the interval, then manages existing positions by attempting to close or reverse them when the price returns to favorable levels. Trading is restricted to specific intraday time windows and filtered by volume and spread conditions.

name: Exp_TrendEnvelopes
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the TrendEnvelopes custom indicator, opening buy positions when an upward trend signal is detected and sell positions when a downward trend signal is detected. It uses configurable money management with lot sizing or deposit share, and applies fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit levels to all trades. The strategy processes signals only on new bars to avoid redundant calculations.

name: Exp_MomentumCandleSign
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom MomentumCandleSign indicator, opening buy positions on bullish momentum signals and sell positions on bearish momentum signals. It includes configurable buy/sell open and close logic, with the ability to scan historical bars for counter-signals to close existing positions. Money management supports multiple margin modes including fixed lot sizing.

name: Exp_ColorSchaffTrendCycle
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffTrendCycle indicator, a momentum-based oscillator that combines moving average convergence/divergence with stochastic smoothing. It opens buy positions when the indicator crosses above the upper threshold and sell positions when it crosses below the lower threshold, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_ColorXCCXCandle
description: This EA trades based on the ColorXCCXCandle custom indicator, which uses dual-smoothed candle coloring to identify trend direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator turns bullish (color=2) and sell positions when it turns bearish (color=0), with configurable entry/exit switches for each direction. Position sizing is managed through multiple money management modes including lot-based, balance percentage, and free margin percentage.

name: Exp_Super_Trend
description: This EA trades based on the Super_Trend custom indicator, which uses CCI to determine trend direction. It opens buy positions when the upper trend signal appears and sell positions when the lower trend signal appears, with optional stop-loss and take-profit. The EA includes money management modes and configurable position open/close switches for both directions.

name: Exp_Dots
description: This EA trades based on the custom 'Dots' indicator, which generates color-coded trend signals. It opens buy positions when the indicator switches from bearish to bullish color and sell positions when it switches from bullish to bearish color, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.

name: Exp_breakeven_trailing_SL
author: Oxy
description: This EA is a position management utility that automatically moves stop loss to breakeven when a position reaches a specified profit threshold, then applies a trailing stop to lock in further gains. It does not open any trades itself; it only modifies existing stop loss levels via CTrade::PositionModify. It supports filtering by symbol and magic number.

name: sentiment_ea
author: MetaQuotes Software Corp.
description: This EA trades based on market sentiment by comparing the ratio of buy vs sell orders and volumes from the order book. It opens positions when one side significantly dominates the other in both trader count and volume, and closes when the sentiment ratio reverses or weakens. Trading is restricted to a specific weekday and intraday time window.

name: MACDWaterlineCrossExpectator
author: Author: laplacianlab, CC Attribution-Noncommercial-No Derivate 3.0
description: This is a basic trading system which consists in buying when MACD crosses above the waterline line and selling when crosses below it. This EA works along with a monetary management system which has a positive mathematical expectation.

name: Exp_VolatilityQuality
description: This EA trades based on the Volatility Quality indicator, which identifies momentum shifts by analyzing price volatility patterns. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from bearish to bullish and sell positions when it transitions from bullish to bearish, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_ColorBears.mq5
description: This EA trades based on the ColorBears custom indicator, which uses dual-smoothed bearish momentum to generate buy and sell signals. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from bearish to bullish color (0→2) and sell positions when it transitions from bullish to bearish color (2→0), with configurable position closing on signal reversals.

name: Exp_ColorBulls
description: This EA trades based on the ColorBulls custom indicator, which uses a two-stage smoothing system to detect momentum shifts. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from neutral to bullish (color change to 2) and sell positions when it transitions from bullish to neutral (color change to 0), with separate controls for entry and exit on each side.

name: KositBablo10-1
author: MetaQuotes Software Corp.
description: This EA trades EURUSD using RSI and MA indicators across D1 and H1 timeframes to generate buy and sell pending stop orders. It places BuyStop/SellStop orders with a reversal (turnover) pending order in version 10-1, and uses a money management system that scales lot size based on free margin. The strategy is a multi-timeframe momentum entry system with fixed TP/SL and conditional pending order placement.

name: Exp_PA_Oscillator
description: This EA trades based on the PA_Oscillator custom indicator, which uses dual smoothing of price data to generate momentum-based buy and sell signals. It opens buy positions when the oscillator crosses above zero and sell positions when it crosses below a threshold, with configurable position closing on signal reversal. The EA supports multiple smoothing algorithms and applied price types for flexible signal generation.

name: Exp_i-GAP
description: This EA trades based on the i-GAP custom indicator, which detects price gaps between consecutive bars. It opens buy positions on upward gaps and sell positions on downward gaps, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels. The EA also supports closing opposite positions when a gap signal occurs in the reverse direction.

name: Exp_LeManTrend
description: This EA uses the custom LeManTrend indicator's fast and slow signal line crossovers to generate buy and sell signals. It opens positions in the direction of the crossover trend and optionally closes opposing positions. Trade management includes configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.

name: Exp_LeManTrendHist
description: This EA trades based on the LeManTrendHist custom indicator, which is a trend-following histogram that compares three smoothed moving average periods (13, 21, 34) to determine trend direction. It opens buy positions when the histogram values rise (Value[0] > Value[1]) and sell positions when they fall (Value[0] < Value[1]), with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels. The EA includes independent toggles for opening and closing positions on both the buy and sell sides.

name: Exp_Laguerre_ROC
description: This EA trades based on the Laguerre ROC (Rate of Change) custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator's color buffer transitions upward to level 4 and sell positions when it transitions downward to level 0. It uses configurable overbought/oversold levels (0.75/0.25) and a gamma smoothing parameter to generate signals, with separate controls for opening and closing long/short positions.

name: Exp_MACDCandle
description: This EA trades based on the MACDCandle custom indicator, generating buy signals when the MACD histogram transitions to bullish (value 2) and sell signals when it transitions to bearish (value 0). It supports two operating modes: histogram crossover and signal line crossover, with configurable position sizing, stop loss, and take profit levels.

name: Exp_KalmanFilterCandle
description: This EA trades based on the KalmanFilterCandle custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend (color value transitions to 2) and sell positions when it signals a downtrend (color value transitions to 0). It uses a Kalman filter to smooth price action into candlestick-like signals and executes trades with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels on each new bar.

name: Exp_AnchoredMomentumCandle
description: This EA trades based on the AnchoredMomentumCandle custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator signals bullish momentum (colored candle value 2) and sell positions when it signals bearish momentum (value 0). It uses configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit levels, with separate controls for enabling/disabling buy and sell entry and exit logic.

name: Exp_MACD-2
description: This EA trades based on the MACD-2 custom indicator with three trend detection modes: histogram direction change, cloud crossover, and MACD zero-line crossover. It opens buy/sell positions and closes opposite positions when the selected trend signal triggers, using configurable lot sizing, stop loss, and take profit.

name: Exp_Loco
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom 'Loco' indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator crosses above zero and sell positions when it crosses below one. It uses a new-bar detection mechanism to avoid redundant signals and supports configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. The strategy operates on a configurable timeframe with separate toggles for opening and closing long/short positions.

name: Exp_Beginner
author: Copyright © 2011, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA uses the custom 'Beginner' indicator to generate buy and sell signals based on momentum reversals detected by the indicator's buffer values. It opens and closes positions based on these signals, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. The EA operates on a specified timeframe and includes new bar detection to avoid redundant signal processing.

name: Exp_ColorBearsGap
description: This EA trades based on the ColorBearsGap custom indicator, which identifies bearish gap patterns using dual smoothing algorithms. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from a neutral state to a bullish signal and sell positions when it transitions to a bearish signal, with configurable position closing on opposite signals.

name: Exp_ColorBullsGap
description: This EA trades based on the ColorBullsGap custom indicator, which uses a dual-smoothing approach to detect bullish momentum gap signals. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from a neutral state to a bullish signal, and opens sell positions when it transitions from an overbought state to a bearish signal. Positions are managed with configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and money management options.

name: Exp_ColorMETRO_DeMarker
description: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the ColorMETRO_DeMarker custom indicator, which applies a step-filtered DeMarker oscillator. It opens buy positions when the fast step line crosses above the slow step line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.

name: Exp_ColorMETRO_Stochastic
description: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the ColorMETRO_Stochastic custom indicator, which applies step-size filtering to a Stochastic oscillator. It opens buy positions when the Stochastic main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable position closing on reverse signals.

name: Exp_iCCI_NR
description: This EA trades based on the iCCI_NR custom indicator, a doubly-smoothed CCI (Commodity Channel Index) variant. It generates buy signals when the indicator crosses upward from zero and sell signals when it crosses downward from four, with configurable position opening and closing logic. The EA uses dual smoothing methods for the CCI calculation to reduce noise and improve signal quality.

name: Exp_SuperWoodiesCCI
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the SuperWoodiesCCI custom indicator, which is a dual-period CCI (Commodity Channel Index) variant. It opens buy positions when the signal CCI buffer crosses above zero and sell positions when it crosses below zero, with configurable permissions for entries and exits. Position sizing uses a money management parameter that can represent either a fixed lot size or a percentage of deposit.

name: Exp_Digital_CCI_Woodies
description: This EA trades based on the Digital CCI Woodies indicator, which uses two smoothed CCI lines to generate buy and sell signals via crossover logic. It opens and closes positions on new bar events when the two indicator buffer lines cross, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. The strategy is a momentum-based system applying multiple smoothing methods to CCI data.

name: Exp_ColorMETRO_WPR
description: This EA uses the ColorMETRO_WPR custom indicator, which combines Williams' Percent Range (WPR) with a step-based metro signal, to generate buy and sell entries. It detects crossover signals between the indicator's two buffers (MPlus and MMinus) to open and close positions. Trade execution is delegated to the TradeAlgorithms library for position sizing and order management.

name: StrategyTesterPracticeTrade
author: SearchSurf (RmDj)
description: This EA is for MT5 and it is  mainly used to Practice Trade on Strategy Tester only. The manual command is taken from the existance of a text file in the MT5 Command text file as follows:

name: Exp_ColorMETRO_XRSX
description: This EA trades based on the ColorMETRO_XRSX custom indicator, which uses a double smoothing algorithm with fast and slow step sizes to generate momentum-based signals. It opens buy positions when the fast metro line crosses above the slow line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable position closing on signal reversals.

name: Exp_TMA
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades breakouts from the TMA (Triangular Moving Average) channel. It opens buy positions when price closes above the TMA plus an upper level, and sell positions when price closes below the TMA minus a lower level, with configurable stop loss and take profit.

name: Exp_MBKAsctrend3
author: Copyright © 2011, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the MBKAsctrend3 custom indicator, which uses a weighted combination of three Williams Percent Range (WPR) indicators with different periods to generate buy and sell signals. It opens positions on signal bar crossovers and closes opposite positions when reversal signals appear, with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit levels.

name: Exp_ADX_Cross_Hull_Style
author: Copyright © 2011, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on signals from the ADX_Cross_Hull_Style indicator for entry direction and the UltraXMA indicator as a trend filter. It opens buy/sell positions when ADX crossover signals align with the UltraXMA trend direction, and closes positions on opposing signals or historical signal searches. The full version also incorporates UltraXMA as an additional confirming filter for trade direction.

name: Night
author: AM2 Group.
description: A night scalping EA that trades only during the Asian session (21:00-06:00 server time) using Stochastic oscillator overbought/oversold signals on the M15 timeframe. It opens buy positions when Stochastic is below the oversold level and sell positions when above the overbought level, with fixed stop loss and take profit, and auto-calculated lot sizing based on free margin.

name: OrderExample
author: Copyright 2009-2016, MetaQuotes Software Corp. ~ edited By 3rjfx : 2016/01/29
description: Expert Advisor for sending trade requests using OrderSendAsync() function.\r\n Handling trading events using OnTrade() handler functions is displayed\r\n Expert Advisor parameters allow setting Magic Number (unique Expert ID)

name: HawaiianTsunamiSurfer
author: Author: laplacianlab, CC Attribution-Noncommercial-No Derivate 3.0
description: This system, based on Momentum indicator, assumes that very strong price movements are determinant. It consists in riding the appearing tsunamis, for instance, an important US Nonfarm Payrolls release. HawaiianTsunamiSurfer works well on AUDUSD, USDJPY and EURUSD. It also works with a lower performance on USDCHF and GBPUSD.

name: Exp_BSI
description: This EA trades based on the BSI (Buy Sell Indicator) custom indicator signals. It opens buy positions when the BSI signals bullish momentum (value transitions to 2) and sell positions when it signals bearish momentum (value transitions to 0), with optional position closing on opposite signals. Money management is configurable via multiple margin modes including lot-based, balance percentage, and free margin percentage.

name: Exp_ColorCoppock
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the ColorCoppock indicator, a momentum-based oscillator derived from the Coppock Curve. It opens buy positions when the histogram turns upward from a decline and sell positions when it turns downward from a rise, with configurable permissions for entry and exit. The strategy operates on a multi-timeframe basis, using a higher timeframe indicator signal to execute trades on the current chart.

name: Exp_Extrem_N
description: This EA trades based on the Extrem_N custom indicator, which identifies market extremums (peaks and troughs). It opens buy positions when an up-signal appears after a down-signal and sell positions when a down-signal appears after an up-signal, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_ForexLine
description: This EA trades based on the custom ForexLine indicator, which uses dual smoothed moving average lines to detect trend direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions when it signals a downtrend, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. Position management is delegated to the TradeAlgorithms library, supporting multiple money management modes.

name: ima_expert
author: Vladimir M.
description: This EA trades based on the rate of change of a custom moving average indicator (ima). It opens buy positions when the MA's relative slope exceeds a threshold and sell positions when it drops below a negative threshold, using a fixed stop-loss in ticks and a trailing stop for profitable positions. Lot sizing is dynamically calculated based on account free margin and risk parameters.

name: exp_multic
author: Copyright 2012-2016, DC2008
description: Expert implements the strategy of multi-currency trading without using technical analysis indicators

name: Exp_RSI_Histogram
description: This EA trades based on the RSI Histogram custom indicator, opening buy positions when the histogram crosses above the low level zone and sell positions when it crosses below the high level zone. It uses configurable money management modes, fixed stop loss and take profit, and processes signals on new bar formation to avoid redundant trading.

name: Exp_MFI_Histogram
description: This EA trades based on the MFI (Money Flow Index) Histogram custom indicator, opening buy positions when MFI crosses above the lower level from the overbought zone and sell positions when MFI crosses below the upper level from the oversold zone. It uses a custom MFI_Histogram indicator with color-coded buffers to determine market direction and executes trades with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit.

name: Exp_WPR_Histogram
description: This EA trades based on the WPR (Williams' Percent Range) Histogram indicator, opening buy positions when the histogram shows bullish momentum above the high level and sell positions when it shows bearish momentum below the low level. It uses a custom WPR_Histogram indicator with configurable overbought/oversold levels and signal bar selection, combined with money management modes for position sizing. Trade exits are triggered by opposing signals from the histogram.

name: Exp_MAOscillatorHist
description: This EA trades based on the MAOscillatorHist custom indicator, which is a moving average oscillator histogram. It opens buy positions when the histogram turns upward from negative territory and sell positions when it turns downward from positive territory, with configurable position closing on opposite signals.

name: Exp_RVI_Histogram
description: This EA trades based on the RVI (Relative Vigor Index) Histogram indicator, supporting two signal modes: level-based and crossover-based. It opens buy positions when the RVI histogram signals upward momentum and sell positions on downward momentum, with configurable position closing on opposite signals. Money management is handled via the TradeAlgorithms library with multiple margin modes.

name: Exp_ColorXMACDCandle
description: This EA trades based on color changes of the ColorXMACDCandle custom indicator, which is an enhanced MACD with multiple smoothing algorithms. It opens buy positions when the histogram turns bullish and sell positions when it turns bearish, with configurable signal modes (histogram or signal line crossover). Position sizing follows one of five money management modes including fixed lot and percentage-based allocation.

name: Exp_Stochastic_Histogram
description: This EA trades based on the Stochastic Histogram custom indicator, supporting two signal modes: level-based (overbought/oversold) and crossover-based. It opens buy positions when the stochastic signals bullish momentum and sell positions when bearish momentum is detected, with configurable position closing on opposite signals. Money management is handled via the included TradeAlgorithms library with multiple margin modes.

name: BB Automated
description: This EA places BuyLimit and SellLimit pending orders at the Bollinger Bands lower and upper bands respectively on every new M15 candle, closing positions when price reverts to the middle band (SMA). It deletes all pending orders at the start of each new bar and replaces them with fresh ones at the updated band levels. The strategy is a classic Bollinger Band mean-reversion system with no stop loss or take profit.

name: Exp_CCI_Histogram
description: This EA trades based on a custom CCI_Histogram indicator, opening buy positions when the histogram transitions from neutral to positive zone and sell positions when it transitions from neutral to negative zone. It uses configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and processes signals only on new bars to avoid over-trading.

name: PositionsChangeInformer
author: Rone.
description: This EA monitors trade transactions and raises alerts (popup, sound, or email) when positions are opened, closed, or reversed. It does not execute any trades itself; it functions purely as a notification utility for position change events.

name: Exp_Laguerre
description: This EA trades based on the Laguerre indicator's trend direction changes, opening buy positions when the trend shifts upward and sell positions when it shifts downward. It uses the ColorLaguerre custom indicator with configurable gamma and threshold levels to generate signals, and includes both entry and exit logic tied to the same indicator flips. Position sizing is handled via the TradeAlgorithms library supporting multiple margin modes.

name: Exp_3LineBreak
description: This EA trades based on the Three Line Break charting indicator, opening buy positions when the trend flips from bearish to bullish and sell positions when it flips from bullish to bearish. It includes configurable money management, stop loss/take profit, and separate controls for opening and closing positions on each side of the market.

name: Exp_ASCtrend
description: This EA trades based on the ASCtrend custom indicator signals, opening buy positions on up signals and sell positions on down signals. It supports configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and optional position closing on opposite signals. The strategy processes signals on new bars and includes a historical scan for close signals when both open and close permissions are enabled.

name: Exp_BykovTrend
description: This EA trades based on the BykovTrend custom indicator, which generates Up/Dn arrow signals. It opens buy positions on Up signals and sell positions on Dn signals, with configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and money management options. Signals are processed on new bars with a recalculation mechanism to ensure data integrity.

name: Exp_Candles_Smoothed
description: This EA trades trend reversals detected by the Candles_Smoothed custom indicator, which applies configurable smoothing algorithms to candlestick data. It opens buy positions on bullish trend transitions and sell positions on bearish trend transitions, with optional position closing on opposite signals and configurable money management based on a percentage of margin.

name: Exp_FiboCandles
description: This EA trades based on the FiboCandles custom indicator, which uses Fibonacci ratio levels to identify trend direction changes. It opens buy positions when the trend shifts upward and sell positions when the trend shifts downward, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit settings.

name: Exp_Go
description: This EA trades based on the custom 'Go' indicator's trend signals, opening buy positions when the trend shifts from bearish to bullish and sell positions when it shifts from bullish to bearish. It includes configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and separate controls for opening and closing positions on each side. The strategy is a classic trend-following system that enters on trend reversal signals.

name: Exp_Heiken_Ashi_Smoothed
description: This EA trades based on trend reversal signals from the Heiken Ashi Smoothed custom indicator. It opens buy positions when the trend changes from bearish to bullish and sell positions when the trend changes from bullish to bearish, with configurable position sizing and stop-loss/take-profit levels.

name: Exp_Karacatica
description: This EA trades breakout signals generated by the custom 'Karacatica' indicator, which is based on ATR. It opens buy positions on upward breakout signals and sell positions on downward breakout signals, with optional position closing on opposite signals. Money management is configurable with multiple margin modes including fixed lot sizing.

name: Exp_LeManSignal
description: This EA uses the custom LeManSignal indicator to generate buy and sell signals based on momentum direction. It opens and closes positions on new bar events, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. The EA includes mutual signal cancellation logic and a historical bar scan for determining close signals when both open and close permissions are enabled.

name: Exp_NonLagDot
description: This EA trades trend reversals signaled by the NonLagDot custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator shifts from downtrend (2) to uptrend (1) and sell positions on the opposite transition. It includes configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and separate toggle switches for opening and closing long/short positions. The EA operates on new bar detection to avoid excessive tick-level trading.

name: Exp_PriceChannel_Stop
description: This EA trades based on the PriceChannel_Stop custom indicator, opening buy positions when the upper channel signal triggers and sell positions when the lower channel signal triggers. It uses a configurable money management system with multiple margin modes and implements both entry and exit signals from the indicator's multiple buffers.

name: Panel for Trade (panel.mq5)
author: Copyright 2010-2016, DC2008
description: This is a semi-automated trading panel EA that provides a graphical interface on the chart for manual trade execution. It allows the user to adjust lot size and execute BUY, SELL, and CLOSE operations via on-chart buttons, with live bid/ask price display that updates on every tick.

name: Exp_Sidus
description: This EA trades based on the Sidus indicator, which uses dual EMA and dual LWMA crossover signals to identify trend direction. It opens buy positions on upward crossover signals and sell positions on downward crossover signals, with configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and money management options.

name: Exp_SilverTrend
description: This EA trades based on the SilverTrend_Signal custom indicator, opening buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals. It supports configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and optional position closing on reverse signals. The strategy is a signal-based breakout system that enters on new bar formations when the indicator produces non-empty values.

name: Exp_Stalin
description: This EA trades based on the custom 'Stalin' indicator, which combines fast/slow moving averages with RSI to generate momentum signals. It opens buy positions on upward momentum signals and sell positions on downward momentum signals, with optional position closing on opposite signals. The EA uses the TradeAlgorithms library for position management and supports multiple money management modes.

name: Exp_StepMA_NRTR
description: This EA trades based on the StepMA_NRTR custom indicator, which is a step-moving average NRTR (No Repaint Trailing Reverse) system. It opens buy positions on upward step signals and sell positions on downward step signals, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. Positions are managed per-bar using new bar detection to avoid redundant signals.

name: Exp_SuperTrend
description: This EA trades based on the SuperTrend indicator, which combines CCI and ATR to determine trend direction. It opens buy positions when the SuperTrend signals an uptrend and sell positions when it signals a downtrend, with configurable position closing on signal reversals. The EA supports multiple money management modes and includes fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels.

name: Exp_JMASlope
author: Copyright © 2013, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the JMASlope indicator, which measures the slope of a Jurik Moving Average. It supports two entry algorithms: zero-line breakthrough (breakdown) and direction change (twist), opening buy/sell positions when the slope signals momentum shifts.

name: Exp_WPRSIsignal
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom WPRSIsignal indicator, which combines WPR (Williams Percent Range) and RSI into a momentum oscillator. It opens buy positions on upward momentum signals and sell positions on downward momentum signals, with configurable position closing and money management options.

name: Panel-joke
author: Copyright 2010-2016, DC2008
description: Panel-joke or a game system

name: Exp_NRTR
description: This Expert Advisor trades based on the NRTR (Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse) custom indicator, opening buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals while optionally closing opposite positions. It uses a configurable money management system with multiple margin modes and includes new bar detection to avoid redundant signal processing on the same bar.

name: Exp_NRTR_extr
description: This EA trades based on the NRTR_extr (Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse Extended) custom indicator, opening buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals. It implements a trailing reverse logic where trend changes trigger both entry in the new direction and exit from the opposite direction. Position sizing is configurable via multiple money management modes including lot-based and percentage-based allocation.

name: Exp_Elliott_Wave_Oscillator
description: This EA trades based on the Elliott Wave Oscillator (EWO), which is calculated as the difference between two smoothed moving averages of different periods. It opens buy positions when the oscillator turns upward from a declining state and sell positions when it turns downward from a rising state, with configurable position closing on signal reversal.

name: Exp_XDPO_Histogram
description: This EA trades based on the XDPO_Histogram custom indicator, which is a detrended price oscillator. It opens buy positions when the histogram turns upward from a declining state and sell positions when it turns downward from a rising state, implementing a mean-reversion oscillator strategy.

name: Exp_ColorXdinMA_StDev
description: This EA trades based on the ColorXdinMA_StDev custom indicator, which combines a dual-length XdinMA moving average with standard deviation filtering. It supports three signal modes (point signals, direct trend detection, or disabled) for both entry and exit, and uses configurable money management with stop loss and take profit.

name: Exp_Bezier_StDev
description: This EA trades based on the Bezier_StDev custom indicator, which combines Bezier curve smoothing with standard deviation bands to identify overbought/oversold conditions. It supports three signal modes (point-based, directional, and disabled) for both entry and exit, and uses configurable money management with stop loss and take profit. The strategy opens buy positions on upward turning points and sell positions on downward turning points of the smoothed curve.

name: Exp_BinaryWave_StDev
description: This EA trades based on the BinaryWave_StDev custom indicator, which combines seven weighted technical indicators (MA, MACD, OsMA, CCI, Momentum, RSI, ADX) into a composite binary wave signal with standard deviation filtering. It supports three signal modes (point signals, direct line direction, or disabled) for both entry and exit, with configurable money management and lot sizing.

name: Exp_ColorHMA_StDev
description: This EA trades based on the ColorHMA_StDev indicator, which is a Hull Moving Average enhanced with standard deviation bands. It opens and closes buy/sell positions using three signal modes: point signals from colored dots, direct trend direction from the HMA line, or disabled signals entirely.

name: Exp_ColorJ2JMAStDev
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom ColorJ2JMAStDev indicator, which combines a J2JMA smoothing filter with standard deviation bands. It supports three signal modes (point, direct, without) for both entry and exit, and uses configurable money management with multiple margin modes to size positions.

name: Exp_ColorJFatl_StDev
description: This EA trades based on the ColorJFatl_StDev custom indicator, which combines a JFATL (JMA-smoothed FATL) moving average with Standard Deviation channels. It opens and closes positions using three signal modes: point-based (dot signals), directional (line direction change), or disabled, allowing flexible entry and exit logic on trend reversals or continuations.

name: Exp_AroonHornSign
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom AroonHornSign indicator, opening buy positions on upward momentum signals and sell positions on downward momentum signals. It supports configurable money management modes, stop-loss/take-profit, and separate toggles for opening and closing positions on each signal direction. The strategy also performs a historical bar scan to detect close signals when both open and close permissions are enabled.

name: Exp_ToCloseProfit
author: Copyright © 2011, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA monitors the account's floating profit and automatically closes all open positions (both long and short) when the total unrealized profit reaches or exceeds a user-defined threshold. It uses a global variable to track whether the profit level has been triggered, ensuring that once the target is hit, all positions are closed even if profit subsequently drops below the threshold.

name: Multicurrency trading panel (DC2008)
author: Copyright 2010-2016, DC2008
description: Multicurrency trading panel (program-joke:) or a game system

name: Exp_ToCloseLoss
author: Copyright © 2011, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA monitors the account's floating profit/loss and closes all open positions (both long and short) across all symbols when the account loss exceeds a user-defined maximum loss threshold. It uses a global variable as a one-time trigger flag to prevent repeated closing attempts once the threshold is breached.

name: Exp_ColorXTRIX_Histogram
description: This EA trades based on the ColorXTRIX_Histogram custom indicator, which is a triple-smoothed momentum oscillator. It opens buy positions when the histogram turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable position closing on signal reversal.

name: MartGreg_1
author: Alf.
description: This EA uses a dual MACD crossover strategy to generate buy and sell signals, combined with a Martingale position-sizing system that doubles the lot size after consecutive losses. It enters trades only when no position is already open, with fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. The OnTester function evaluates profitability relative to maximum drawdown.

name: Exp_XDPOCandle
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom XDPOCandle indicator, which uses dual smoothing algorithms to generate colored candle signals. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals bullish momentum (color value 2) and sell positions when it signals bearish momentum (color value 0), with configurable position closing on signal reversal.

name: madelta_ea
author: Winston 2013
description: madelta_ea

name: Exp_trend_arrows
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom 'trend_arrows' indicator, opening buy positions on upward trend arrows and sell positions on downward trend arrows. It includes configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and options to independently control buy/sell opening and closing. The strategy uses a new bar check to avoid redundant signal processing on the specified timeframe.

name: Exp_VWAP_Close
description: This EA trades based on the VWAP_Close custom indicator, generating buy signals when VWAP values are rising (trend up) and sell signals when VWAP values are falling (trend down). It uses configurable money management modes, fixed stop loss and take profit levels, and processes signals on new bar formation to avoid redundant trades. The strategy is a systematic trend-following approach that enters in the direction of the VWAP momentum.

name: Exp_Directed_Movement
description: This EA trades based on the crossover of the Directed Movement indicator's upper and lower lines, which are derived from a doubly-smoothed RSI. It opens buy positions when the upper line crosses above the lower line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable position closing and money management options.

name: Exp_CCI_Woodies
description: This EA trades based on the crossover of fast and slow CCI (Woodies) indicators. It opens buy positions when the fast CCI crosses above the slow CCI and sell positions when the fast CCI crosses below the slow CCI. Positions are closed on opposite crossover signals, with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit levels.

name: Exp_Q2MA
description: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the Q2MA custom indicator, which uses configurable smoothing algorithms (SMA, EMA, JJMA, T3, etc.). It opens buy positions when the upper indicator line crosses above the lower line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with optional position closing on signal reversal. Money management supports multiple margin modes including fixed lot sizing.

name: Exp_MaChannel
description: This EA trades based on the MaChannel custom indicator, which builds a smoothed moving average channel. It opens buy positions when price breaks above the upper channel and sell positions when price breaks below the lower channel, with opposite-direction close signals generated as well.

name: Exp_ROC2_VG
description: This EA uses a dual Rate-of-Change (ROC2_VG) custom indicator with two configurable momentum-type calculations (MOM, ROC, ROCP, ROCR, ROCR100) on different periods to generate crossover signals for opening and closing buy/sell positions. It features money management options, stop loss/take profit, signal inversion, and processes signals only on new bars for efficiency.

name: Exp_TSICloud
description: This EA trades based on the TSI Cloud indicator, which uses double-smoothed momentum (TSI) with configurable smoothing methods. It opens buy positions when the upper TSI line crosses above the lower line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with optional signal inversion and separate close-on-reversal logic.

name: AutoTrader
author: AM2
description: This EA is a session-based trading toggle utility that automatically enables or disables the MetaTrader AutoTrading button (Ctrl+E) based on a user-defined time window. Outside the active trading session, it also closes all open positions. It does not generate its own trade signals or open positions based on a strategy.

name: ArbSint
author: Dmitrievsky Max.
description: ArbSint is a statistical arbitrage EA that exploits price divergence between correlated or cointegrated instruments. It opens opposing positions when the spread deviates beyond a threshold and closes them when the spread reverts to the mean. The strategy is inherently market-neutral, aiming to profit from relative value convergence rather than directional movement.

name: Exp_ColorRsiMACD
description: This EA trades based on the ColorRsiMACD custom indicator, which applies RSI smoothing with configurable averaging methods before computing a MACD-style oscillator. It offers four trading modes: MACD zero-line breakdown, MACD direction twist, signal line twist, and MACD-vs-signal disposition crossover, opening and closing positions accordingly.

name: Exp_Directed_Movement_Candle
description: This EA trades based on the Directed_Movement_Candle custom indicator, which uses a dual-smoothed RSI approach to determine directional momentum. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals bullish momentum (color value 2) and sell positions when it signals bearish momentum (color value 0), with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. The EA uses a new bar detection mechanism to avoid redundant signal processing and supports both trade opening and closing based on indicator signals.

name: Exp_iRSISign
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom iRSISign indicator, which generates buy and sell signals when RSI crosses user-defined overbought and oversold levels. It opens and closes positions according to these RSI crossover signals, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit settings.

name: Exp_iWPRSign
description: This EA trades based on the iWPRSign custom indicator, which generates buy and sell signals from Williams' Percent Range (WPR) crossing overbought/oversold levels. It opens and closes positions systematically on new bar signals, with configurable money management modes and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels.

name: Exp_Chaikin_Volatility_Stochastic
description: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the Chaikin Volatility Stochastic custom indicator. It opens buy positions when the oscillator lines cross downward and sell positions when they cross upward, with configurable money management and position closing logic. The strategy operates on a multi-timeframe basis using a selectable higher timeframe for signal generation while executing on the current chart timeframe.

name: Exp_iStochKomposter
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom iStochKomposter indicator, a Stochastic-based oscillator with overbought/oversold levels. It opens buy positions on oversold signals and sell positions on overbought signals, with configurable close-on-opposite-signal logic. Position sizing uses a flexible money management system supporting lot, free margin, balance, and loss-based modes.

name: Exp_ColorJFatl_Digit
description: This EA trades based on the ColorJFatl_Digit custom indicator, which combines JMA smoothing with FATL digital filtering. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend (value=2) and sell positions when it signals a downtrend (value=0), with configurable position closing on trend reversal signals. Money management supports multiple margin modes including fixed lot, balance percentage, and free margin percentage.

name: Exp_ColorX2MA_Digit
description: This EA trades based on the ColorX2MA_Digit custom indicator, which uses a dual moving average crossover system with digit rounding. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from neutral (0) to bullish (>0), and sell positions when it transitions from neutral (2) to bearish (<2), with configurable money management and position closing logic.

name: Multik_SMA_Exp
author: Copyright © 2010, Nikolay Kositsin
description: A multicurrency Expert Advisor that trades up to 12 currency pairs simultaneously using SMA slope direction. It generates buy signals when the SMA is rising for two consecutive periods and sell signals when the SMA is falling, with position management handled independently per symbol.

name: Exp_iDeMarkerSign
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom iDeMarkerSign indicator, which identifies overbought and oversold conditions using DeMarker oscillator levels. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an upward crossover above the lower level and sell positions when it signals a downward crossover below the upper level, with configurable close-on-opposite-signal logic. Position sizing is managed via a money management module supporting multiple margin modes.

name: Exp_FRASMAv2
description: This EA trades based on the FRASMAv2 (Fractal Adaptive Simple Moving Average v2) custom indicator signals. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from a neutral state to a bullish signal and sell positions when it transitions to a bearish signal, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_Volume_Weighted_MA
description: This EA trades based on the Volume Weighted Moving Average indicator, generating buy signals when the VWMA turns upward and sell signals when it turns downward. It compares three consecutive VWMA values to detect trend direction changes and uses configurable money management modes for position sizing. Entries and exits are controlled separately with boolean toggles, and StopLoss/TakeProfit levels are applied to all positions.

name: cm Universal Trailing Stop Hedge
author: Copyright © 2016, cmillion@narod.ru
description: Советник перемещает стоплосс в сторону движения цены различными методами по свечам, по фракталам, по индикаторм ATR MA Parabolic, по проценту профита и просто по пунктам

name: Timer Trade
author: Oschenker
description: This EA places alternating Buy and Sell orders on a fixed timer interval, creating a hedging position system. Each trade includes a Stop Loss and Take Profit, and the direction alternates between buy and sell on each timer trigger.

name: Exp_Volume_Weighted_MA_StDev
description: This EA trades based on signals from the Volume Weighted MA with Standard Deviation channels indicator. It opens buy positions when the VWMA turns upward or when buy signal dots appear, and sell positions on downward turns or sell dots. Position sizing supports multiple margin modes and standard stop-loss/take-profit controls are provided.

name: Exp_Fisher_org_v1
description: This EA trades based on the Fisher_org_v1 custom indicator, which produces a main line and a signal line. It opens buy positions when the main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.

name: Exp_Fisher_org_v1_Sign
description: This EA trades based on signals from the Fisher_org_v1_Sign custom indicator, which uses a Fisher Transform with ATR normalization to identify momentum-based buy and sell signals. It opens buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels, and supports multiple money management modes including lot-based and percentage-based sizing.

name: Exp_JFatl_Digit_System
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom JFatl_Digit_System indicator, which combines a JMA-based digital filter with digit-level rounding. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions on a downtrend, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.

name: Exp_Volume_Weighted_MA_Digit_System
description: This EA trades based on signals from the Volume_Weighted_MA_Digit_System custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator shows bullish signals (column value >2 and color <3) and sell positions when it shows bearish signals (column value <2 and color >1). It includes configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options with separate controls for opening and closing positions.

name: Trade panel with autopilot
author: DC2008
description: Trade panel with autopilot. Example of MasterWindows library.

name: Exp_Volume_Weighted_MACandle
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom Volume Weighted MACandle indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator transitions to bullish (color=2) and sell positions when it transitions to bearish (color=0). It uses fixed stop loss and take profit levels with configurable money management and allows independent control of entry and exit directions.

name: GurooEx01
author: Copyright © 2010, Marketing Dreams Ltd.
description: An example of an OOP random entry system

name: Exp_Donchian_Channels_System
description: This EA trades Donchian Channel breakouts by reading signals from a custom Donchian Channels System indicator. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an upward breakout and sell positions on downward breakouts, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.

name: Exp_PChannel_System
description: This EA trades based on the PChannel_System custom indicator, opening buy positions when price breaks above the channel and sell positions when it breaks below. It uses a price channel system with configurable period and shift to generate breakout signals, with independent controls for opening and closing positions on each side.

name: Exp_DarvasBoxes_System
description: This EA implements the Darvas Boxes trading system, which identifies box-shaped trading ranges and trades breakouts from those ranges. It uses the custom DarvasBoxes_System indicator to detect upward and downward breakout signals, then opens buy or sell positions accordingly. The system includes configurable money management, stop loss/take profit, and separate controls for opening and closing positions on both sides.

name: Exp_ADXDMI
description: This EA trades based on the ADXDMI custom indicator, which appears to be an ADX/DMI-based trend following system with signal line crossovers. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_AroonOscillatorSignAlert
description: This EA trades based on the Aroon Oscillator indicator with alert signals. It opens buy positions on upward crossover signals and sell positions on downward crossover signals, with configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and money management options.

name: Exp_TrendContinuation
author: Copyright © 2013, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades trend continuation signals generated by the custom TrendContinuation indicator. It detects crossovers between the indicator's upper and lower buffer lines to open buy or sell positions, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. Trading is restricted to new bar formation on the specified timeframe to avoid redundant signals.

name: Exp_i-CAi
description: This EA trades based on the custom i-CAi indicator, which is a smoothed moving average crossover system. It opens buy positions when the indicator values turn upward and sell positions when they turn downward, with configurable position sizing and stop loss/take profit levels.

name: NarrowestRangeSignal EA
author: Rone.
description: The Expert Advisor based on the NarrowestRangeSignal indicator. If there is no position,  stop orders will be set in both sides of the range by the signal of the indicator.  When either of orders triggers, the opposite order is deleted.

name: Exp_SMI_Correct
description: This EA trades based on the SMI Correct indicator, which is a Stochastic Momentum Index variant with multi-layer smoothing. It generates buy signals when the SMI main line crosses above the signal line and sell signals on the reverse crossover, with configurable position sizing and stop loss/take profit management.

name: Pipser
author: Alf.
description: A semi-automated trading panel EA that places Buy and Sell market orders via on-chart buttons. It applies a fixed stop loss with automatic 5-digit broker adjustment and uses a fixed lot size without take profit.

name: Exp_i-CAi_StDev
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom i-CAi_StDev indicator, which combines a smoothed moving average with standard deviation bands. It supports three signal modes (point signals, direct line direction, or disabled) for both entry and exit, and includes money management with multiple margin modes.

name: ZZFiboTrader
author: (C) OSCHENKER, 2016
description: This EA uses a custom ZigZag Fibonacci indicator to identify key Fibo price levels, then enters trades on breakouts confirmed by candlestick patterns. It manages open positions with a parabolic SAR-style trailing stop loss system, dynamically adjusting the stop as the trend progresses.

name: Exp_i-CAiChannel_System_Digit
description: This EA trades based on the i-CAiChannel_System_Digit custom indicator, which generates digit-based channel signals. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an upward breakout (digit value > 2) and sell positions when it signals a downward breakout (digit value < 2), with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_PFE
description: This EA trades based on the Polarized Fractal Efficiency (PFE) indicator, entering long when PFE rises and short when PFE falls. It uses the CXMA smoothing library for signal generation and supports configurable money management modes including lot-based and percentage-based position sizing. The EA operates on a new bar basis with separate controls for opening and closing positions.

name: Exp_PFE_Extr
description: This EA trades based on the Polarized Fractal Efficiency (PFE) indicator, opening buy positions when PFE crosses above the upper level and sell positions when it crosses below the lower level. It uses multiple smoothing methods via the CXMA library and supports configurable money management modes including fixed lot and margin-based sizing. The strategy operates as a zero-lag crossover system on extreme PFE level breaches.

name: ASCTrendND
author: Alain Verleyen
description: Trading strategy based on ASCTrend indicator as main signal. Filtered by NRTR indicator and/or by TrendStrength indicator. See this topic for more information http://www.mql5.com/en/forum/10741

name: Exp_PPO_Cloud
description: This EA trades based on the PPO (Percentage Price Oscillator) Cloud indicator, which uses dual smoothing methods for fast and slow PPO lines plus a signal line. It opens buy positions when the PPO crosses above the signal line from below, and sell positions when the PPO crosses below the signal line from above, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.

name: Exp_CandlesticksBW
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom CandlesticksBW indicator, opening buy positions when bullish candlestick patterns are detected and sell positions when bearish patterns are confirmed. It uses a dual-buffer signal system (buffer 4) with threshold comparisons to generate entry and exit signals, and employs fixed Stop Loss/Take Profit levels with configurable money management.

name: SARTrailingSystem
author: Oschenker
description: This EA implements a Parabolic SAR-style trailing stop system that manages open positions by dynamically adjusting the stop-loss based on an acceleration factor mechanism. It opens random trades (buy or sell with equal probability) on a timer interval, then trails the stop-loss using SAR logic with configurable acceleration step and cap. The strategy has no directional bias for entries and relies entirely on the SAR trailing mechanism for exits.

name: Exp_RAVI_Histogram
description: This EA trades based on the RAVI (Range Action Verification Index) Histogram indicator, which measures momentum by comparing fast and slow moving averages. It opens buy positions when the RAVI histogram crosses above the upper threshold and sell positions when it crosses below the lower threshold, with corresponding close signals on opposite crossovers. Position sizing is configurable via multiple money management modes including lot-based and percentage-based approaches.

name: Exp_i-SpectrAnalysis_RVI
description: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the i-SpectrAnalysis_RVI custom indicator, which applies spectral analysis to the RVI (Relative Vigor Index). It opens buy positions when the RVI main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable position sizing and stop-loss/take-profit levels.

name: Exp_i-SpectrAnalysis_WPR
description: This EA trades based on a spectral analysis filter applied to the Williams Percent Range (WPR) indicator. It identifies turning points in the smoothed WPR line to generate buy and sell signals, opening and closing positions accordingly with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit levels.

name: Exp_wlxBW5Zone
description: This EA trades based on the wlxBW5Zone custom indicator, which appears to be a Bill Williams Zone-based momentum indicator. It opens buy positions on upward zone signals and sell positions on downward zone signals, with configurable entry/exit toggles, fixed stop loss/take profit, and multiple money management modes.

name: TicksFile
author: 2010, Avatara"                   //  10.08.10
description: This EA is a data-logging utility that records tick data and bar data to a CSV file in real time. It captures completed bar OHLCV data alongside incoming tick details (ask, bid, last, volume) and writes them to a timestamped file. It does not open, manage, or close any trading positions.

name: Demo_FileWriteArray
author: MetaQuotes Software Corp.
description: This EA is a file-writing utility that collects bid/ask price data and datetime stamps on every tick, storing them in a structured array. Once the array reaches its capacity (20 elements), it writes the accumulated data to a binary file and resets the counter. It serves as a demonstration of MQL5's FileWriteArray function for persisting structured data to disk.

name: Exp_BalanceOfPower_Histogram
description: This EA trades based on the Balance of Power (BOP) histogram indicator, which measures the strength of buyers vs sellers. It opens buy positions when BOP values are rising (buyers gaining strength) and sell positions when BOP values are falling (sellers gaining strength), with configurable smoothing applied to the indicator values.

name: Exp_i-SpectrAnalysis_Chaikin
description: This EA trades based on the i-SpectrAnalysis_Chaikin custom indicator, which applies spectral (Fourier) analysis to the Chaikin Oscillator. It opens buy positions when the spectrally-filtered Chaikin value turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable position closing on signal reversal.

name: Exp_RVIDiff
description: This EA trades based on the RVIDiff custom indicator, which applies additional smoothing (T3 by default) to the Relative Vigor Index. It opens buy positions when the RVI value rises above its prior value during a downtrend in the RVI, and opens sell positions when the RVI falls below its prior value during an uptrend, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.

name: FibonacciRetracement
author: Oschenker
description: This EA uses ZigZag indicator to identify swing highs and lows, then constructs Fibonacci retracement levels on the most recent ZigZag leg. It enters buy trades when price crosses above Fibonacci support levels in an uptrend, and sell trades when price crosses below Fibonacci resistance levels in a downtrend, with stop-loss and take-profit based on Fibonacci extension.

name: Exp_STLMCandle
description: This EA trades based on signals from the custom STLMCandle indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator signals bullish momentum and sell positions on bearish momentum. It uses a Jurik-style smoothed indicator (JLength/JPhase parameters) to determine trend direction from candle color states. Entry and exit are controlled by separate boolean flags, allowing selective enablement of long/short opening and closing.

name: Exp_StochasticDiff
description: This EA trades based on the StochasticDiff custom indicator, which applies an additional smoothing algorithm to the Stochastic Oscillator. It opens buy positions when the smoothed Stochastic value turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable position closing on opposite signals.

name: synccharts
description: This EA synchronizes all open charts in the terminal to match the active chart's timeframe, scale, scroll position, chart mode, and vertical line objects. It runs on a 200ms timer, continuously propagating the source chart's view settings to every other chart. It does not place any trades or manage positions.

name: Exp_ColorXvaMA_Digit
description: This EA trades based on the ColorXvaMA_Digit custom indicator, which applies a double-smoothing approach using two configurable moving average methods. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions when it signals a downtrend, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit settings.

name: HelloSmart
author: AM2
description: HelloSmart is a Martingale-style grid EA that opens positions at fixed price intervals (Step) and multiplies lot size by a Mnogitel factor when total position volume exceeds BigLot. It closes all positions when a profit target or loss limit is reached, then resets lot size to the initial value.

name: NightScalper
author: AM2
description: A multi-symbol night scalping EA that trades Bollinger Band mean reversion signals during specific time windows. It opens buy positions when price touches the lower band and sell positions when price touches the upper band, provided band width is below a threshold. Positions are closed when the trading session ends and new trades are only opened on new bars.

name: Exp_AFL_WinnerV2
description: This EA trades based on the AFL_WinnerV2 custom indicator, which produces color-based momentum signals (values 0-3). It opens buy positions when the indicator shifts to bullish momentum (value 3) and sell positions when it shifts to bearish momentum (value 0), with configurable signal confirmation and position closing logic. Position sizing uses a money management system with multiple modes including lot-based, balance percentage, and free margin percentage.

name: Profit Loss Calculator
author: Rone.
description: Profit Loss Calculator

name: Exp_JSatl_Digit_System
description: This EA implements a trend-following trading system based on the JSatl (Jurik Satl) digital filter indicator, which combines Jurik-style smoothing with adaptive trend-line analysis to identify and follow market trends. It generates buy and sell signals when the JSatl indicator changes direction or crosses threshold levels, opening positions in the direction of the detected trend. The system includes configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters along with position sizing controls.

name: TralingLine
author: Viktorov
description: TralingLine is a trailing stop utility EA that dynamically adjusts stop-loss levels by following a trend line drawn on the chart. It does not open its own positions but instead manages existing positions by moving their stop-loss to track a user-defined or algorithmically placed trend line, locking in profits as the market moves favorably.

name: Exp_CandleTrend
author: Copyright © 2013, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA generates trading signals based on a simple candlestick trend pattern: it opens a buy position when a configurable number of consecutive bullish candles appear, and a sell position when the same number of consecutive bearish candles appear. It includes stop loss, take profit, and multiple money management modes via the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library.

name: Exp_ColorJSatl_Digit
description: This EA trades based on the ColorJSatl_Digit indicator, which is a digital signal processing-based trend-following indicator that changes color to indicate trend direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator turns bullish (color change to upward) and sell positions when it turns bearish, with configurable position management and exit logic.

name: Exp_Waddah_Attar_Trend
description: This EA implements the Waddah Attar Trend indicator-based trading strategy, which combines MACD and Bollinger Bands to identify trend direction and strength. It enters long positions when the indicator shows a bullish trend with sufficient momentum and short positions for bearish trends, exiting when the trend weakens or reverses. The EA applies a systematic trend-following approach with configurable parameters for sensitivity and risk management.

name: Exp_FigurelliSeries
author: Copyright © 2013, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the Figurelli Series indicator, which uses a basket of Moving Averages with varying periods to determine trend direction. It opens positions at a specified start time and closes them either by opposing signals or at a specified stop time. Position sizing supports multiple margin modes including fixed lot, free margin, and balance-based calculations.

name: Exp_i4_DRF_v2
description: This EA implements a trend-following strategy based on the i4 (Institutional Index) and DRF (Dynamic Range Filter) indicators, opening positions in the direction of the prevailing trend when the dynamic range confirms momentum. It uses version 2 of the system with improved entry filtering and trade management logic.

name: Exp_JSatlCandle
description: This EA is a trend-following expert advisor based on the JSatl (JSA Trend Line) indicator combined with candlestick pattern analysis. It generates buy signals when the JSatl indicator confirms an uptrend and candlestick patterns support continued upward momentum, and sell signals under the opposite conditions. The EA automates trade entry, exit, and position management based on these combined technical signals.

name: Exp_Bear_Bulls_Power
description: This EA trades based on the Bears Power and Bulls Power indicators developed by Alexander Elder. It enters long positions when Bulls Power is positive and rising, and short positions when Bears Power is negative and falling, using EMA as the trend filter.

name: Exp_i4_DRF_v3
description: This EA implements a trend-following strategy based on the i4 (Intraday Intuition Index) and DRF (Dynamic Range Filter) indicators, entering trades when both indicators align in the same direction. It uses dynamic range filtering to identify trend conditions and the i4 indicator for momentum confirmation, with version 3 incorporating additional filtering and risk management refinements. The system operates systematically with predefined entry/exit rules and adjustable position sizing.

name: Exp_QQECloud
author: Copyright © 2013, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the QQECloud indicator, which uses a smoothed RSI with variable smoothing methods to generate trend signals. It opens buy positions when the upper cloud line is above the lower cloud line and sell positions when the reverse is true, with time-restricted entry and exit windows. Position sizing supports multiple margin modes and includes configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.

name: Exp_ColorXvaMA_Digit_StDev
description: This EA trades based on the ColorXvaMA_Digit indicator with StDev (Standard Deviation) filtering. It enters positions when the colored moving average changes direction, confirmed by standard deviation volatility conditions. The strategy combines a digitally-smoothed variable-period moving average with volatility filtering for trend reversal entries.

name: Exp_Color3rdGenXMA
author: Copyright © 2013, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on signals from the Color3rdGenXMA custom indicator, which uses a third-generation moving average with configurable smoothing methods. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend (value=2) and sell positions when it signals a downtrend (value=0), with time-based entry filtering and position holding duration limits.

name: Exp_Delta_RSI
description: This EA trades based on the Delta RSI indicator, which measures the difference between two RSI periods to detect momentum shifts. It enters long positions when the delta between fast and slow RSI crosses above a threshold and short positions when it crosses below. The strategy aims to capture momentum reversals before they become apparent on a single RSI reading.

name: Rock-Trader-Neuro
author: Suresh Kakkattil.
description: This EA uses a single-layer artificial neuron with hyperbolic tangent activation to generate trading signals from Bollinger Band indicator values. It normalizes the ratio of Bollinger Band width to base line across 7 bars as neuron inputs, buys when the neuron output is negative, and sells when positive. Positions are managed with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.

name: tootrix
author: Alf.
description: This EA uses TriX indicator crossovers to generate buy/sell signals with a martingale position sizing system. It enters long when the fast TriX turns up and the slow TriX is rising, and enters short on the inverse condition, applying lot doubling after losses. Fixed stop loss and take profit levels are set on each trade.

name: Exp_Delta_MFI
description: This EA trades based on the Delta MFI (Market Facilitation Index) indicator, which combines volume analysis with price range movements to identify momentum shifts. It enters positions when the delta between current and previous MFI values signals strengthening or weakening market facilitation, typically used to catch trending moves driven by volume participation.

name: Exp_Delta_WPR
description: This EA trades based on the delta (change) of the Williams' Percent Range (WPR) indicator, entering positions when the momentum shift of WPR exceeds a threshold. It uses fixed lot sizing with stop loss and take profit for trade management.

name: Exp_RSI_Slowdown
description: This EA trades based on RSI slowdown signals, detecting when the RSI indicator's momentum decelerates in overbought or oversold zones as a precursor to trend reversal. It enters trades when RSI shows signs of slowing down near extreme levels, aiming to capture reversal moves. The strategy is a momentum-based mean reversion approach using RSI divergence in momentum rather than price.

name: Exp_F2a_AO
author: Copyright © 2013, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA uses a multi-timeframe approach combining a higher-timeframe trend filter (daily candlestick direction) with the F2a_AO custom indicator signals on a lower timeframe (H12) to generate buy and sell entries. It opens long positions when the trend is bullish and the F2a_AO oscillator gives an up signal, and short positions when the trend is bearish and a down signal appears, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.

name: Exp_WPR_Slowdown
description: This EA trades based on the Williams' Percent Range (WPR) indicator slowdown pattern, entering positions when the WPR momentum decelerates after reaching extreme overbought or oversold zones. It identifies momentum exhaustion as a reversal signal and executes trades accordingly. The strategy aims to capture turning points where price momentum fades near extremes.

name: Exp_MFI_Slowdown
description: This EA trades based on the Money Flow Index (MFI) slowdown pattern, detecting when the MFI indicator momentum decelerates after reaching extreme overbought or oversold zones. It opens trades anticipating a reversal when MFI momentum fades, signaling potential price exhaustion and trend change.

name: BolBands
author: AM2.
description: This EA trades Bollinger Bands mean reversion signals confirmed by a DEMA trend filter. It buys when a bullish candle crosses above the lower Bollinger Band while DEMA is rising, and sells when a bearish candle crosses below the upper Bollinger Band while DEMA is falling. Positions are closed on opposite band crossing signals.

name: Exp_Trigger_Line
description: This EA trades based on the Trigger Line indicator, which is a variation of the Linear Regression Channel or moving average crossover system. It opens buy positions when the fast trigger line crosses above the slow trigger line and sell positions on the reverse crossover, implementing a systematic trend-following strategy with configurable lot sizing and stop levels.

name: Exp_XMACandles
description: This EA trades based on the XMACandles indicator, which generates colored candlesticks derived from multiple moving average calculations. It opens buy positions when the indicator candles turn bullish (blue/green) and sell positions when they turn bearish (red), following the trend direction signaled by the XMA crossover logic.

name: exp_x2ma_jfatl
description: This EA uses a dual moving average crossover system combined with the JFATL (Jurik Fast Adaptive Trend Line) indicator to generate trend-following trade signals. It enters long positions when the faster MA crosses above the slower MA and JFATL confirms the trend direction, and enters short positions on the reverse condition. The system applies a systematic approach with configurable parameters for MA periods, JFATL settings, and risk management.

name: Multi_Lot_Scalper
author: Copyright © 2005, Alejandro Galindo
description: A scalping EA that employs a martingale-style multi-lot progression strategy, doubling or increasing lot sizes after losing trades to recover losses. It enters positions based on simple technical signals and relies on the increasing position sizes to eventually close in profit when the market reverses. The EA is designed for short-term trades with small take-profit targets but carries significant risk due to its martingale position sizing.

name: exp_x2ma_jjrsx
description: This EA generates trading signals based on the crossover of two moving averages (x2MA) combined with the Jurik RSX (JJRSX) momentum indicator as a filter. It enters long when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and JJRSX confirms bullish momentum, and enters short on the reverse conditions. The strategy is a systematic trend-following system with momentum confirmation.

name: exp_x2ma_digit_dm_361
description: This EA uses a dual moving average (x2MA) crossover system with digital signal processing and a decision matrix (DM) to generate trend-following trade entries. It combines two smoothed moving averages to detect trend direction changes and applies a 3/6/1 decision logic to filter signals and manage positions.

name: CyberiaTrader
author: Copyright c 2006, Cyberia Decisions
description: CyberiaTrader is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that identifies rapid price movements and enters trades in the direction of momentum spikes. It uses a proprietary calculation method to detect abnormal price action velocity and executes market orders with fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels. The EA is designed for high-frequency trading on M1-M15 timeframes with aggressive entry timing.

name: DayTrading
author: Copyright © 2005, NazFunds Company
description: DayTrading is an Expert Advisor designed for intraday scalping on lower timeframes. It enters trades based on momentum and short-term trend signals, targeting small price movements with tight take-profit levels.
