The EA aims to capture multiple small gains throughout the trading session while using stop-loss protection on each trade.

name: 20 200 expert v 4.2 AntS
author: Smirnov Pavel
description: This EA implements a dual moving average crossover strategy using a 20-period and 200-period moving average, with AntS (Anti-Stop or Anti-S) enhancements in version 4.2. It enters long positions when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and short positions on the reverse crossover, incorporating additional filters and stop management logic.

name: e-Regr
author: © 2008 BJF Trading Group
description: e-Regr is an Expert Advisor that trades based on linear regression channel analysis, entering positions when price deviates from the regression line and reverts back toward it. It uses the regression channel to identify overextended price moves and capitalizes on the statistical tendency of prices to return to their mean. The EA systematically opens buy or sell trades when price touches or crosses the regression channel boundaries.

name: The MasterMind 2
author: Copyright © 2008, CreativeSilence, Inc.
description: The MasterMind 2 is a Martingale-based EA that opens trades based on a primary signal (typically a momentum or trend indicator) and doubles the lot size after each consecutive loss, aiming to recover all previous losses with a single winning trade. It operates without a hard stop-loss, relying instead on the Martingale progression and an optional take-profit target to close positions. The strategy inherently carries exponential risk as losing streaks rapidly escalate position sizes.

name: Artificial Intelligence
author: Copyright © 2006, Yury V. Reshetov ICQ:282715499  http://reshetov.xnet.uz/
description: This EA implements a neural network-based trading system that uses a perceptron model to classify market conditions and generate buy/sell signals. It trains the network on historical price data and uses the trained weights to predict future price direction, executing trades when the network output exceeds a threshold.

name: Opening and Closing on Time
author: Copyright © 2016, Vladimir Karputov
description: This EA automatically opens and closes positions at user-specified times of day, allowing traders to exploit time-based market patterns such as session opens or scheduled volatility windows. It places market orders at designated times and closes all positions at a specified closing time, functioning as a simple time-based trading system. The EA relies purely on time triggers rather than technical indicators for entry and exit decisions.

name: exp_3sto
description: An Expert Advisor that uses three Stochastic oscillators across different timeframes to generate trading signals. It aligns signals from higher timeframes for trend direction and lower timeframes for entry timing, executing trades when all three Stochastic conditions are met simultaneously.

name: exp_3rvi
description: This EA trades based on the 3-period Relative Vigor Index (RVI) indicator, generating buy and sell signals when the RVI main line crosses its signal line. It opens positions in the direction of the crossover and manages trades with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.

name: RobotPowerM5 meta4V12
author: Copyright © 2005
description: RobotPowerM5 is an M5 timeframe momentum-based Expert Advisor that generates trade signals from a combination of oscillators and trend filters. It enters positions when momentum indicators confirm directional strength and exits via fixed take-profit or stop-loss levels. The EA includes lot sizing and basic risk controls but appears to lack advanced money management features.

name: Exp_GStopLoss
author: Copyright © 2016, Nikolay Kositsin
description: Exp_GStopLoss is a utility Expert Advisor that manages stop loss levels for open positions, likely implementing a global or trailing stop loss mechanism. It does not open trades on its own but instead modifies existing positions' stop loss to protect profits or limit losses. The EA monitors all open positions and adjusts their SL according to configurable rules.

name: Exp_MUV_NorDIFF_Cloud
author: Copyright © 2011, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on the MUV_NorDIFF_Cloud custom indicator, which generates buy signals from its upper cloud buffer and sell signals from its lower cloud buffer. It opens and closes positions on new bar signals with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. The strategy also searches historical bars to determine the last trading direction for position closing when no immediate close signal is present.

name: Exp_GTakeProfit
author: Copyright © 2016, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA implements a grid trading strategy with a global take-profit mechanism. It places pending orders at fixed price intervals and closes all positions once a combined profit target is reached. The strategy relies on price oscillation within a range to capture incremental profits across multiple orders.

name: MTC Combo v2
author: Copyright © 2008, Yury V. Reshetov
description: Тетсирование разных индикаторов, смещений...

name: PivotHeiken 3
author: orBanAway aka cucurucu
description: This EA combines Pivot Point levels with Heiken Ashi candlestick analysis to generate trade signals. It identifies entry opportunities when Heiken Ashi candles confirm direction near pivot support/resistance levels, and manages trades with take profit and stop loss based on pivot structure. The strategy aims to capture reversals or breakouts at key pivot levels confirmed by Heiken Ashi trend direction.

name: Exp_GStop
author: Copyright © 2016, Nikolay Kositsin
description: Exp_GStop is a utility Expert Advisor that manages trailing stops and guaranteed stop-loss levels for open positions. It does not open trades on its own but instead monitors existing positions and dynamically adjusts stop-loss orders to protect profits. The EA provides automated risk management by trailing stops based on configurable parameters.

name: 2MA Bunny Cross Expert
author: Ron Thompson
description: This EA implements a dual moving average crossover strategy known as the 'Bunny Cross,' generating buy signals when a fast MA crosses above a slow MA and sell signals on the reverse crossover. It systematically opens and closes positions based on these crossover events, making it a classic trend-following system. The EA is designed for automated execution without manual intervention.

name: exp_centerofgravitycandle
description: This EA trades based on the Center of Gravity indicator applied to candle data, entering positions when price deviates from the calculated center of gravity and expecting a reversion to the mean. It generates buy signals when the COG value is at the lower band and sell signals when at the upper band, typically using crossover or extreme-level detection for entries. The strategy systematically opens and closes positions based on these oscillator-style signals without discretionary input.

name: OpenTicks
author: Copyright © 2008, ZerkMax
description: Analysis of 4 previous bars

name: Exp_TimesDirection
author: Copyright © 2016, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA trades based on time-of-day directional signals, analyzing price movement direction during specific time windows to determine trade entries. It opens positions when the market direction aligns with historically favorable time-based patterns, typically operating during sessions where directional bias is strongest.

name: Exp_ZeroFillingStop
author: Copyright © 2015, Nikolay Kositsin
description: Эксперт переводит позицию в безубыток, то есть ставит стоплосс на уровне цены открывания позиции, при достижении ценой финансового актива количества пунктов прибыли, которое определяется входными параметрами эксперта

name: DVD Level
author: Copyright © 2010
description: DVD Level is an EA that trades based on key price levels (support/resistance or pivot points) to identify high-probability entry zones. It systematically opens positions when price interacts with these calculated levels, aiming to capture reversals or breakouts from significant price zones. The EA likely uses level-based logic to determine trade direction and manages positions with defined exit criteria.

name: Scalpel EA
author: ryaz
description: Scalpel EA is a scalping expert advisor designed for high-frequency, low-profit-per-trade entries on small timeframes. It uses precise entry signals based on price action and technical indicators to capture small price movements with tight take-profit targets. The EA aims to accumulate profits through a large number of quick trades rather than holding positions for extended periods.

name: Exp_TralingStop
description: This EA is a trailing stop utility that modifies existing positions' stop loss levels to follow price movement, locking in profits as the market moves favorably. It does not open its own trades but manages stop loss levels on already-opened positions based on configurable trailing parameters.

name: Exp_ReOpenPositions
description: This EA is a utility tool that re-opens positions after they are closed, either manually or by stop loss/take profit hits. It monitors closed positions and replicates them with the same direction, volume, and instrument, functioning as a position recovery or persistence tool rather than a strategy-based trading system.

name: EMA_CROSS
author: Coders Guru
description: This EA trades EMA crossover signals between a short-period and long-period EMA. It opens buy positions when the short EMA crosses above the long EMA and sell positions on the opposite cross, with fixed take-profit, stop-loss, and a trailing stop for open position management.

name: Fibo iSAR
author: FORTRADER.RU
description: This EA combines Fibonacci retracement levels with the Parabolic SAR indicator (iSAR) to identify trend-following entry opportunities. It opens trades when price aligns with key Fibonacci levels and the Parabolic SAR confirms trend direction. The strategy aims to capture trend continuations after pullbacks to Fibonacci zones.

name: Exp_RSI

description: This EA trades based on MACD signal line crossovers combined with trend filtering, entering long positions when MACD crosses above its signal line in an uptrend and short positions when it crosses below in a downtrend. It uses standard MACD indicator values to generate systematic entry and exit signals without discretionary intervention. The strategy aims to capture momentum shifts confirmed by MACD histogram direction changes.

name: BuildYourGrid EA v1.8
author: Copyright 2020-2023, Nikolaos Pantzos
description: \nThe expert is a grid system with option for progressing lot size. \nUse expert on pair with tight spread and low commission broker.

name: BotCilentoV1.35
author: Lupus Materia Ltd.
description: BotCilentoV1.35 is an MQL5 Expert Advisor that appears to implement a scalping strategy on lower timeframes. It likely uses a combination of technical indicators to generate short-term trade signals with tight take-profit targets. The EA is designed for automated execution without manual intervention.

name: TarantellaV1.37
author: Copyright © 2025, lupusmat@gmx.com
description: TarantellaV1.37 is a trend-following Expert Advisor for MetaTrader 5 that identifies directional momentum and enters trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It uses a combination of moving average-based trend detection and momentum confirmation filters to generate entry signals, with built-in stop-loss and take-profit management. The EA employs systematic position sizing and trailing stop mechanisms to protect profits while riding trends.

name: EMA_RSI_RISK_EA
description: This EA combines EMA trend direction with RSI momentum signals to generate trade entries, while incorporating risk management rules based on account equity and position sizing. It opens buy positions when price is above EMA and RSI confirms upward momentum, and sell positions when price is below EMA and RSI confirms downward momentum. The strategy applies fixed risk-per-trade position sizing and includes stop loss and take profit controls.

name: Multi Divergence EA
author: Le Trung Kien Hoang
description: This EA detects divergence patterns across three momentum indicators (RSI, MACD, Stochastic) and enters trades when a configurable minimum number of confirmations align. It applies trend and volume filters before opening positions, and uses fixed lot sizing or risk-based money management with configurable stop loss and take profit.

name: Spread lister current-min-max
description: This utility EA monitors and displays the current, minimum, and maximum spread values for the trading instrument. It does not open any trades but serves as a spread monitoring tool for traders who want to track spread conditions in real-time.

name: Close all orders
author: Copyright 2024
description: Close all Market and Pending orders with button click

name: CincinV2.24
author: Copyright © 2025, Lupus Materia Ltd, Yashar Seyyedin, barabashkakvn, SalmanSoltaniyan
description: Optimized EA with structs for conservative random trading, basket management, and hedging.

name: TardioBot V1.05
author: Lupus Materia Ltd.
description: TardioBot V1.05 is a multi-timeframe Expert Advisor that combines trend detection on higher timeframes with entry signals on lower timeframes. It uses a delayed/late-entry approach (hence 'Tardio') to confirm trend direction before executing trades, aiming to filter out false signals. The EA manages positions with configurable stop loss, take profit, and trailing stop mechanisms.

name: Scalping Dashboard V2
description: This is a scalping dashboard/utility tool that displays multi-symbol and multi-timeframe scalping signals on a panel, typically based on indicators like RSI, Stochastic, MACD, or moving averages. It does not open trades autonomously but provides visual signal alerts and dashboard information to assist manual scalping decisions.

name: Quantum Gold Silver Trader
author: MetaQuotes Software Corp.
description: AI-Enhanced Quantum Trading System for Gold and Silver

name: Simple_Grid
description: This EA implements a simple grid trading strategy that places buy and sell pending orders at fixed price intervals above and below the current price. It aims to profit from market oscillations by capturing gains as price moves back and forth through grid levels. The strategy does not rely on any technical indicators and operates purely on price geometry.

name: HedgeCoverV1.04
description: HedgeCover EA - Intelligent Position Protection System Provides safe hedging with multiple risk controls Free for MT5 community - Use at your own risk

name: Risk Calculator
author: Jhonatan Morais
description: This EA is a risk calculation utility that helps traders determine appropriate position sizes based on their account equity, risk percentage, and stop-loss distance. It does not open, close, or manage any trades on its own; instead, it provides computed lot size recommendations to assist with manual trading decisions. The tool serves as a money management aid for disciplined position sizing.

name: MartingalePulse
author: SPLpulse
description: A versatile Expert Advisor combining multiple trading strategies with advanced risk management. Features include Martingale, dynamic lot sizing, trailing profit, trading sessions, and daily profit/drawdown limits.

name: The RSI Engine v2.1
author: The RSI Engine MT5 EA by SPLpluse
description: The RSI Engine is a multi-signal RSI-based Expert Advisor that trades bullish/bearish divergences and overbought/oversold reversals with optional centerline confirmation. It includes risk management with dynamic lot sizing, trailing stops, daily profit/loss limits, news filtering, and configurable trading hours. The EA opens one position at a time and manages exits via RSI level crosses or trailing stops.

name: ExpWPRBB
author: MetaQuotes Ltd.
description: This EA combines the Williams Percent Range (WPR) oscillator with Bollinger Bands to identify overbought and oversold reversal conditions. It enters long positions when WPR is oversold and price is near the lower Bollinger Band, and enters short positions when WPR is overbought and price is near the upper Bollinger Band. Exits are triggered by opposite signals or when price reaches the opposite Bollinger Band.

name: ExpPinBar
author: MetaQuotes Ltd.
description: ExpPinBar is an Expert Advisor that identifies pin bar candlestick reversal patterns and executes trades based on them. It scans for bullish and bearish pin bars as signals of potential market reversals, entering positions in the direction of the implied reversal. The EA includes configurable pattern recognition thresholds and basic risk management via stop loss and take profit.

name: BabiNgepet_07
author: zvickyhac
description: Babi Ngepet - Martingale Scalping

name: OneClickCloseAll
author: Hezekiah Oyetunde
description: One-Click Close All Positions with Advanced Filters

name: Grid MasterB
author: Fox Wave
description: Grid MasterB is a grid trading Expert Advisor that places buy and sell pending orders at fixed price intervals around the current market price, aiming to profit from market oscillations within a range. It systematically manages a grid of orders by spacing them at configured distances and optionally uses lot multiplication after losing trades. The EA continuously opens new grid levels as price moves, capturing profits from each grid line hit.

name: Fox Wave Clean
author: Fox Wave QCW
description: Fox Wave Clean is an Elliott Wave-based EA that identifies wave patterns (impulse and corrective waves) on multiple timeframes to generate trade signals. It enters positions at the end of corrective waves (wave 2 or wave 4) anticipating the next impulse wave. The EA uses a rule-based wave counting algorithm with Fibonacci retracement levels for entry and take-profit placement.

name: TradePad_Sample
description: This EA is a trade pad/dashboard utility that creates a visual table of symbol buttons on the chart, color-coded by trend direction (up, down, flat). It does not open trades itself; it provides an interactive panel for the trader to click symbols and monitor trend states via periodic timer updates.

name: TelegramTradeNotify
author: Copyright © 2026, Ngo The Hung (thehung21)
description: Utility EA: sends trade execution notifications to Telegram via Bot API (sendMessage).

name: DataTraderH4Breakout
author: Mueller Peter
description: This EA implements a New York session open breakout strategy that forms a range during the first 4 hours of NY local time (00:00-04:00 NY) and enters trades on M5 when price breaks above resistance or below support. Stop loss is placed at the lowest low or highest high of the preceding candles within the range, with take profit set at 2x the stop loss distance. It includes DST-aware time conversion between server time and New York time.

name: Playground v1.04
author: MetaQuotes Ltd.
description: Experimental Encroachment Scalping - Simple & Clean

name: Larry Williams ONNX
description: This EA uses an ONNX (Open Neural Network Exchange) machine learning model to implement a Larry Williams-style trading strategy. It feeds market data into a pre-trained neural network model to generate buy/sell signals, combining Larry Williams' proven trading principles with modern deep learning inference for automated trade execution.

name: RiskCalc
author: Hezekiah
description: Basic Risk Calculator for Position Sizing FREE VERSION - Get Pro Risk Manager for advanced features https://www.mql5.com/en/market/product/162502

name: RiskSizer Panel Lite
author: © 2026, Ngo The Hung (thehung21)
description: RiskSizer Panel Lite is a risk management utility panel for MetaTrader 5 that calculates position sizes based on user-defined risk percentage and stop-loss distance. It provides a visual interface for traders to quickly determine appropriate lot sizes before placing trades, ensuring consistent risk per trade. The EA does not open positions itself but serves as a companion tool for manual or semi-automated trading.

name: Trend Momentum EA
author: User
description: This EA trades momentum signals in the direction of the trend, defined by price being above or below both EMA 50 and EMA 200. It enters longs when RSI is deeply oversold (10-25) with a bullish stochastic crossover in an uptrend, and shorts when RSI is overbought (80-90) with a bearish stochastic crossover in a downtrend. Trading is restricted to London and New York sessions only.

name: MarketStructure
description: An ONNX-based Expert Advisor that uses a machine learning model to classify market structure into 4 categories, then places Fibonacci-based pending limit orders when model confidence exceeds a threshold. It combines ML predictions with a 50-period MA trend filter and employs RR-based trailing stops.

name: SidewaysMartingale
author: zvickyhac
description: This EA uses an ONNX-based machine learning model to detect sideways market conditions and enters trades at Envelope band boundaries. When a position goes against it, it applies a Martingale recovery strategy by multiplying lot size and adding positions at fixed pip distances. It exits when the total floating profit of all positions reaches a USD target or when margin drawdown exceeds a threshold.

name: VR Locker Lite
author: @ Voldemar"                                      // Copyright information
description: VR Locker Lite is a hedging-based Expert Advisor that opens opposing positions to lock in profits or limit losses when the market moves against an initial trade. It uses a locker mechanism to open a hedging order when a defined loss threshold is reached, effectively creating a locked position until a breakout or recovery signal allows closure. The EA manages both the original and hedging positions together, aiming to exit the overall basket at a profit or minimal loss.

name: Price Action Day Trader
author: Price Action Day Trader
description: A daily price action EA that identifies pin bar, engulfing, and inside bar candlestick patterns to generate trade signals, filtered by EMA trend direction and support/resistance proximity. It employs risk-based position sizing, daily loss limits, breakeven and trailing stop management, with automated broker filling mode detection for robust order execution.

name: VR Breakdown level
author: @ Voldemar"                                      // Copyright information
description: This EA implements a simple breakout strategy that trades when price breaks above the previous bar's high (BUY) or below the previous bar's low (SELL). It monitors open positions on each tick and sets Stop Loss and Take Profit levels if they are missing or need updating. The strategy resets breakout levels after a trade is triggered, waiting for the next new bar to establish fresh levels.

name: Impulse Continuation Engine [ICE_Pro]
author: MT5 Developer
description: RITZ Impulse Continuation Engine Pro.\nAdaptive filters for reliable entries

name: MASTER_WINNERFX_GOLD_MT5
author: Muhammad Asim
description: This EA is a grid trading system for gold (XAUUSD) that uses EMA trend direction and RSI momentum for initial entries, then adds up to 3 martingale-scaled grid positions at fixed pip intervals when price moves against the trade. All positions are closed when combined profit reaches a target or loss exceeds a maximum risk threshold.

name: exp_trendmagic
author: Copyright © 2014, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA implements the Trend Magic strategy, which combines the Commodity Channel Index (CCI) with Average True Range (ATR) to generate a trailing stop line that changes color based on trend direction. It opens buy positions when the Trend Magic line turns bullish and sell positions when it turns bearish, using the indicator line as both entry signal and dynamic stop loss. The strategy aims to capture sustained trends while providing clear exit signals through trend reversal detection.

name: eq3-06 / e04lc07-v4
description: D The stake should be decreasing after the winning bet, ... and increasing after the loosing one.

name: LoongClock
description: LoongClock is a non-trading utility EA that displays a clock on the chart. It uses a timer event to update the clock every second and supports both local and server time sources via a configurable input parameter.

name: Monitor
author: Copyright 2006-2012, FINEXWARE GmbH
description: This EA is a multi-terminal price monitor that uses memory-mapped files (shared memory via DLL) to exchange bid prices between multiple MetaTrader 5 instances running on the same machine. It continuously writes its own terminal's bid price to shared memory and reads bid prices from other connected terminals, displaying horizontal price lines on the chart for comparison. It does not open any trades and serves purely as a monitoring and price comparison utility.

name: AskBidTicks
author: 2012-2015 Erdem Sen
description: AskBidTicks is a high precission tick data collector for microstructure analysis. It It works with local computer time (for Windows).

name: Example1_LibCustomChart
author: Lizar
description: The Expert Advisor shows the application of LibCustomChart.ex5 library. The presence of iCustomChart custom chart is checked when attaching the Expert Advisor to a chart window. In case a custom chart has been uploaded, the library functions use the data of that chart. Otherwise, the data of a standard chart is used. Therefore, the Expert Advisor can work both with custom and standard charts without the need for any changes.

name: SymbolSynthesizer
author: alohafx
description: This EA is a dialog-based utility panel that displays synthetic symbol relationships for forex triangular arbitrage/hedging. It shows 13 predefined currency pair triplets with their Long/Short synthesis direction, updating prices on each tick via a custom GUI dialog.

name: EA_MARSI_1-02
author: Copyright © 2012
description: This EA uses a dual EMA-smoothed RSI crossover system to identify trend reversals. A slow and a fast EMA_RSI_VA indicator generate signals when they cross: a bullish crossover opens a buy, a bearish crossover opens a sell, closing any existing opposite position first. It supports optional dynamic lot sizing based on account balance and a configurable drawdown cap.

name: Moving Averages With Frames
author: MetaQuotes Software Corp.
description: This EA trades based on a simple Moving Average crossover signal where price crossing the SMA triggers entries and exits. It includes optimized lot sizing that reduces position size after consecutive losses, and integrates MetaTrader's FrameGenerator for visualizing optimization results during backtesting.

name: IndicatorParameters_Demo
author: MetaQuotes Software Corp.
description: This is a utility EA that monitors chart indicators for changes (additions/removals) and retrieves their parameter information using the IndicatorParameters() function. It listens for CHARTEVENT_CHART_CHANGE events, compares the current indicator list with the previous snapshot, and prints details about added or deleted indicators along with their input parameters.

name: Champion
author: AM2.
description: This EA uses RSI overbought/oversold levels to place pending Buy Stop and Sell Stop orders in the direction of momentum. It opens three orders at a time with dynamic lot sizing based on free margin, and trails stop losses while modifying pending order prices to follow the market. Take profit and stop loss are fixed pip-based values.

name: BeeLine
author: Evgeniy Trofimov
description: This EA implements a pairs trading / statistical arbitrage strategy between two correlated currency pairs (e.g., EURUSD and GBPUSD). It measures the price deviation between a base and an indirect instrument using a compaction-normalized spread, opening hedged positions when deviation exceeds a dynamic signal border and closing when the spread reverts. Periodic re-optimization calibrates the relationship parameters from a rolling historical window.

name: EA_CCIT3_1-01
author: Copyright © 2012, Im_hungry
description: This EA trades based on zero-line crossovers of a CCI T3 smoothed indicator. It opens a buy when CCIT3 crosses above zero and a sell when it crosses below zero. An optional trade overturn mode reverses positions on opposite signals, and a trailing stop feature manages open positions.
